title: media buyer and creative strategiest
description:
TITLE:

Meta & TikTok Media Buyer + Creative Strategist – Italy, UK & US E-commerce – Full-time, Long-term



ABOUT US

RINOVA (
) sells new and refurbished tech: iPhone, PlayStation, Apple, Sony, Samsung and more.

We are live in Italy and launching RINOVA UK and RINOVA US.

Paid ads are our #1 sales channel. We're looking for ONE person to own paid acquisition and creative

strategy across all 3 markets, and to help us build the UK and US stores from zero.

This is a long-term role, not a project. We want someone who grows with us.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Media buying (Meta + TikTok)

- Plan, launch and manage conversion campaigns on Meta Ads and TikTok Ads for Italy, UK and US

- Set up and structure new ad accounts for UK and US (separate accounts, pixels, currencies)

- Monitor spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPM and frequency every day, and act within hours, not at month-end

- Run structured creative testing and scale the winners

- Check tracking health (Meta Pixel, Conversions API, TikTok Pixel, Events API) and flag issues

- Weekly report in Google Sheets + a short Loom video: what happened, why, what's next



Creative strategy

- Analyze winning ads, ours and competitors' (Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center)

- Write creative briefs for statics, carousels and UGC videos (hooks, angles, offers, formats)

- Create and edit ads in Canva and CapCut from our product photos and UGC footage

- Build and maintain a monthly testing roadmap for each market

- UK and US: you write the final ad copy

- Italy: we write the final Italian copy; you lead strategy, hooks, structure and visuals



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience for E-COMMERCE brands (not lead gen only)

- Real experience with TikTok Ads conversion campaigns

- You have personally managed at least $5,000/month in ad spend

- Proven results with US and/or UK customers

- Experience launching a new store or ad account from zero (cold start, finding first winners)

- Strong with numbers: you can clearly explain ROAS vs MER and CPA vs AOV

- Good skills in Canva and CapCut (or similar)

- Excellent written English

- Reliable internet connection + power backup (UPS / powerbank / mobile data)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with electronics, refurbished tech or consumer tech e-commerce

- Experience with European markets

- Experience managing multiple brands or markets at the same time

- Knowledge of Google Ads



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday

- At least 4 hours overlap with Italian business hours (9:00–13:00 Italy = 16:00–20:00 PH)

- Availability for occasional checks during US hours when we launch new campaigns



COMPENSATION

- $500–700 USD/month base salary, depending on experience

- + monthly performance bonus up to $300, based on agreed KPIs for Italy, UK and US (ROAS / CPA targets)

- Always paid on time, twice a month

- 13th-month pay

- Paid Philippine public holidays

- Salary review after 6 months, based on results



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review

2. Short paid test task ($25)

3. Video interview (30 minutes)

4. Paid trial week

5. Long-term contract



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be read.



Start your application with the word "RINOVA" and answer these questions:

1. What is the largest monthly ad budget you personally managed? In which niche? What ROAS or CPA did you achieve?

2. Describe one campaign you scaled: the starting point, what you changed, and the result.

3. Have you ever launched ads for a brand new store in the US or UK? What did the first 30 days look like?

4. Search "RINOVA" in the Meta Ad Library. What is the first thing you would test, and why? (max 5 lines)

5. Attach 2–3 screenshots of ad account results (you can blur brand names).

6. Your expected monthly salary and when you can start.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: AI Video Editor (Meta Ads, AI Video & Voice Tools) | US DTC Brand, Team Based in Southeast Asia | Full Time
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Full Time, Remote

WAGE / SALARY: $800 - $1,400 per month, based on skill, plus performance bonuses



➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand, selling to women across the US. Our team is based in Southeast Asia (Bangkok time). Our growth engine is paid video ads on Meta, and we need one editor to own that production from end to end.

We are not the average brand that posts one ad a week. We test new video ads every day, and the editor is the engine of that machine.



➤ This is not a cutting job. It's a creative job.

We don't need someone who trims clips. We need someone who looks at any winning ad, understands why it works, and rebuilds the format for our product with AI tools, fast. We send a reference and a script, you find the recipe and deliver the finished ad.

And you own the result. You check your own work before we see it: the hands, the skin, the labels, the lip sync. Nothing fake ships.



➤ What you will make

1. B-roll ads with an AI voiceover (our daily format)

• We give you a validated script and a B-roll bank. You follow the script word for word, pick the shots, generate the voice, edit and caption.

2. Mixed ads

• Real B-roll plus AI B-roll, AI avatars, talking heads.

3. Full AI formats

• AI UGC, 3D and Pixar-style animation, skeleton ads, singing ads, drama ads.

4. New formats as they show up

• We send a reference, you find the recipe.



As the owner of video production, you will also:

• Build and maintain our B-roll bank and our library of proven formats.

• Suggest new formats and hooks when you see something work.

• Report what slows you down (assets, briefs, tools) to the founder, with a suggested fix.



Product accuracy is non-negotiable: every AI shot must look exactly like the real product.

We provide all the AI tools. You bring the skill, we bring the stack.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 100% remote, long term.

• You can overlap 4 hours a day with Bangkok time (ICT). The rest of your hours are flexible.

• Fast, reliable internet: you upload heavy video files every day.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 1+ year editing paid social video ads, vertical, for a DTC or e-commerce brand or an ad agency, with a portfolio to show for it. This is required.

• Must have: you use AI video and voice tools every day (Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Seedance, ElevenLabs or similar), including full AI-generated ads from scratch. If you don't use them today, this role is not for you.

• You can look at any ad and rebuild the format.

• You catch what looks fake: hands, skin, labels, lip sync.

• You work fast and you don't need hand-holding.

• You read carefully. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about your 3 best ads with the word banana.

• Bonus: you have written scripts or hooks yourself.



➤ Who we want

We're scaling hard right now. We want someone who is all in: full-time, with real hours to give, hungry to learn, and here to grow with us for the long run. This is a high-output role: what matters to us is the ads you ship, not hours on a timesheet. In return, the performance bonuses are serious.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 $800 - $1,400 per month, paid on time, every month. Strong skills get the top of the range.

📊 Performance bonuses on winning ads. They are serious.

🚀 A real growth path: lead editor when we hire more video editors, creative strategist if you have the eye for it.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder.

🌴 100% remote, flexible hours outside the 4-hour overlap.



Status: independent contractor. The salary is gross, and you handle your own taxes.



➤ A word from the founder

I'm looking for someone with taste and ownership. My goal is simple: within a few weeks, I send you a reference and a script, and the ad comes back finished, without me fixing anything. You catch the fake hand before I do. In return: your salary grows with your results, you earn bonuses on winning ads, and you get more responsibility as the brand grows.



➤ How to apply

Apply through this form: 

Applications sent any other way will not be considered. Please don't DM.



➤ Our hiring process

1. Application form, about 5 minutes plus a short Loom

2. Short paid test

3. Quick video call with the founder

4. You start. The first week is a paid trial week, then it's a long-term role

title: Senior PPC Manager & Brand Growth Strategist
description:
This is not a campaign-execution job. As a Senior PPC Manager you grow brands, oversee client accounts, and lead the way our team works with AI: building the tools and processes that take over repetitive work, and making sure what they produce is right. We are looking for someone who thinks, sees the bigger picture, and makes the whole team better.



🟢 About Growster ⚫️

Growster is a boutique Amazon growth agency based in Germany, founded by former aggregator brand owners. We work with 7- and 8-figure brands in the EU, UK and US. Our PPC Managers are also the account managers: they own the account and the client relationship. And we are moving our whole way of working to AI-assisted workflows that our own team designs, builds and checks.

🔘What you will do

✦Own a portfolio of brands end to end: growth, profit, margin, TACOS and the P&L, not only the ad console.

✦Go beyond bid management. Connect PPC with organic rank, listing, images, CTR, CVR, pricing, stock and promotions, and flag when the problem is not PPC at all.

✦Design and build AI-assisted tools and processes that optimize our workflows and improve the ones we already have, and get the team using them.

✦Oversee accounts with a sharp eye. Check AI output before it reaches a client or an account, correct what is wrong, and own the result.

✦Put analysis, prevention and growth ahead of busywork: spot problems before they show up in the numbers, fix the cause, and add a check so it does not happen again.

✦Lead client communication: clear, proactive and honest, including client calls, decisions and hard news. Share wins, problems and plans before the client asks.

✦Work as part of the team and raise its level: help teammates do things on their own, mentor newer PPC managers, share what you learn and build, and disagree openly and constructively. This matters as much as your own results.

🔘The person we are looking for

✦Analytical. You start from the data and you know which numbers matter.

✦High-agency. You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be told.

✦Holistic. You think about the whole brand, not one channel.

✦AI-sharp. You build with AI and you catch it when it is wrong.

✦Honest. You say what is really happening, to the client and to us, including your own mistakes.

✦Collaborative and coachable. You make the people around you better, and you take feedback well.

🔘Who we are not looking for

🚫Checklist-only operators who follow steps without asking why.

🚫Yes-men. We want people who push back with reasons.

🚫Siloed specialists who only look at the ad console.

🚫Vanity-metric chasers who report impressions while profit slips.

🚫People who measure their value in hours and task lists. We do not need a daily "here is everything I did" report. We need the right things done and the wrong things prevented.

🚫Relays for AI. If you pass on what an AI says without checking it, this is not the role for you: every output that reaches a client or an account is yours.

🚫Part-time or freelance arrangements. This role is full-time.

🔘What success looks like after 6 months

✦You run a portfolio of brands end to end, and the clients see measurable growth.

✦At least one AI-assisted tool or process you built is used by the whole team.

✦Problems on your accounts are caught and prevented before clients notice them.

✦Teammates and clients come to you as a trusted voice.

🔘What you bring

✦3+ years owning Amazon accounts, with growth you can prove: case studies with numbers, ideally on 7- or 8-figure brands.

✦AI workflows or tools you built (with Claude, ChatGPT, automations, scripts or sheets) that changed how you or your team work, and how you check what they produce.

✦Analytical depth: Search Query Performance, search-term and placement data, bulk files, spreadsheets, and P&L thinking (break-even ACOS, TACOS, margin).

✦Strong command of the levers around PPC: SEO and keywords, listing and image content, pricing, inventory and profitability.

✦Excellent written and spoken client communication in English.

🔘What we offer

✦Salary: $1,300 to $2,300 per month (negotiable).

✦Full-time and fully remote, with flexible hours judged on results. We need a working overlap with German business hours for team and client calls.

✦A lean team that builds and shares its own AI tools.

🔘How to apply

✦Record a 5-minute intro video (Loom or similar) covering: who you are and which role you are applying for, why Growster, and your experience (challenges, meaningful projects, where you want to grow).

✦Take the free Mensa Norway IQ test at

. We're building story-driven short-form ads (TikTok/Reels style, 9:16, 30–120 sec) in a Pixar-style 3D look, mixed with UGC and AI-generated video. We need an editor who can turn AI-generated clips and creator footage into ads that hook people in the first 3 seconds.

title: Junior Video Editor
description:
Part-time Video Editor for Instagram Reels | JUX Food



Remote · 4 hours per week to start, with room to grow hours 



We’re JUX, a UK food brand making freeze-dried herbs and chopped veg. We’re looking for a part-time video editor to help us edit our cooking hacks series for Instagram.



Each hack is a 15–20 second Reel showing one practical kitchen trick. It could be a shortcut that saves time on prep, a way to fix a common cooking problem or a clever use for an everyday ingredient. The viewer should come away knowing how to try it themselves. You can get a feel for the format and pace on our 
 you’ll be doing

- Turn footage filmed by our team into 15–20 second vertical videos. We’ll send you the clips and a short brief for each hack.

- Pick an opening hook that sparks curiosity, cut the demonstration so it’s easy to follow and give the viewer a clear look at the result.

- Add captions and on-screen text in the style of our existing Reels, then make any edits following feedback.

- Occasionally edit a short video for a
 or Instagram ad. The cooking hacks will be your main focus.

Who we’re looking for

- Must feel confident using tools like capcut.



This would suit a junior editor who enjoys making short-form videos and has a good sense of timing. We’re happy to see work you’ve made for your own Instagram or TikTok. An interest in food and cooking is a plus.



How to apply



Please send us two or three examples of short videos you’ve edited, along with your hourly rate and availability for around 4 hours a week. If you’ve edited a food or how-to video, we’d love to see it.

title: Executive & Personal Assistant to Business Owners
description:
Executive & Personal Assistant to Business Owners



Type of work: Full-time, remote  

Salary: ₱40,000–₱55,000/month, depending on experience  

Hours per week: 40  

Employment: Long-term



About Us



We are the owners of STRONG Pilates Port Moody, a growing fitness business based in British Columbia, Canada.



We're looking for a highly organized, proactive and resourceful Executive & Personal Assistant to support us across our professional and personal lives.



As business owners, we want to focus more of our time on strategy, growth and planning. We need someone who can take ownership of the day-to-day administration, coordination, execution and follow-through that bring those plans to life.



The ideal candidate is someone who anticipates needs, thinks critically, works independently and brings solutions to us for approval rather than waiting for step-by-step direction.



We're looking to build a long-term relationship with someone who can grow alongside us and our business.



Compensation & Benefits



- ₱40,000–₱55,000/month, depending on experience.

- 13th-month bonus.

- Salary review after six months.

- Performance-based salary increases and opportunities for professional growth.

- Flexible working hours with sufficient overlap during Canadian business hours.

- Long-term, stable employment with a growing business.



Working Hours



Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week. Our preferred working hours are approximately 10 AM – 6 PM Pacific Time, although we are open to discussing a flexible schedule that works for both parties and provides sufficient overlap with our Canadian business hours.



Key Responsibilities



Executive & Administrative Support



- Manage our business and personal calendars, including meetings, appointments and reminders.

- Manage inboxes, prioritize correspondence and draft responses for approval.

- Maintain a centralized to-do list, ensuring priorities, deadlines and commitments are tracked.

- Proactively follow up on outstanding
s, tasks and action items.

Bookkeeping & Financial Administration

Personal & Family Assistance

- Research and coordinate travel, flights, accommodations and itineraries.

- Manage personal and family appointments, commitments and reservations.

- Coordinate personal events and celebrations.

- Research and compare products, services and purchases.

- Coordinate household administration and service providers.

- Manage online orders, returns, deliveries and renewals.

- Support general personal administration and organization.



What We're Looking For



- At least two years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or Virtual Assistant.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong critical thinking, research and problem-solving abilities.

- Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working with minimal supervision.

- Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt as needs change.

- Confidence communicating professionally on behalf of business owners.

- Strong follow-through and accountability.

- Technologically savvy and comfortable learning new systems.

- High level of discretion, confidentiality and professionalism.

- Reliable internet connection and a backup plan for power or internet outages.



Preferred Experience



- Directly supporting entrepreneurs or small business owners.

- Google Workspace, Slack, spreadsheets and project management tools.

- AI tools and workflow automation.

- Financial administration, invoice management and payroll support.

- Scheduling or CRM software such as Hapana or Mindbody.

- Event planning and vendor coordination.



How to Apply



Start your application with the word **"Reformer."** Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your relevant experience.

2. Examples of how you've supported previous business owners or executives.

3. The software, systems and AI tools you're proficient in.

4. An example of a task or project you independently managed from start to finish.

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

6. Your availability and preferred working hours.

7. A 1–2 minute voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a good fit for this role.



We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure and organization to a fast-paced environment, takes initiative and is motivated by seeing projects through from start to finish.



We value trust, accountability and open communication. Our goal is to build a long-term working relationship where you feel valued, supported and empowered to take ownership of your role as our business grows.

title: Senior Accountant – Vacation Rental & Trust Accounting (US Real Estate)
description:
ABOUT US

We're a fast-growing vacation rental management company in the North Georgia mountains (USA). We manage short-term rental cabins for homeowners, run our own portfolio of rental properties, and are scaling from 10+ homes toward 100+. We're a lean, entrepreneurial team that runs on modern systems, automation and AI, and we expect every person on the team to own their seat.



We're not looking for someone to just "do the books." We want an accountant who builds, improves, and helps us make better decisions with the numbers.



THE ROLE

You'll own accounting for three related US companies: a property management company (with an owner trust account), a real estate company that owns short-term rentals, and a holding company. You'll close the books, reconcile trust funds, prepare owner statements, and turn reports into insights the founders use to run the business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Books and close

- Classify and reconcile all transactions in QuickBooks Online at least 3x per week; books always match the bank

- Deliver weekly financial reports every Friday and full monthly packages by the 5th, including month-end journal entries (depreciation, prepaid amortization, accruals)

- Track results by property using classes, so every home has its own P&L



Trust and owner accounting

- Manage the owner trust account: monthly reconciliation, owner balances, amounts due to/from owners, and fees moved from trust to operating

- Prepare monthly owner statements and payouts in our property management system (Hospitable), tied out to QuickBooks

- Book owner pass-through costs (supplies, repairs, trash) correctly as reimbursables, not income

- Prepare monthly lodging/hotel-motel tax figures for county filings



Insights and decisions

- Don't just send reports. Tell us what changed, why, and what we should do about it

- Flag margin issues, unusual spend, cash timing, and properties underperforming

- Build and maintain cash flow projections



Build and improve

- Find at least one way each week to make our financial reporting faster, cleaner, or more useful

- Use AI tools (we use Claude daily) and automation to cut manual work: rules, imports, reconciliations, recurring entries

- Own and maintain accounting SOPs so the function scales as we add homes

- Research the right treatment when something new comes up, document it, and bring us the answer, not just the question



WHO YOU ARE

- Accountable. You hit deadlines without being chased. If something will slip, you say so early with a plan.

- A critical thinker. You ask "why does this number look like that?" before we do.

- An owner. You take initiative, propose projects, and finish them.

- A builder who loves to learn. You enjoy fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments where systems are still being built and you get to shape them.

- Comfortable with feedback. You clear review comments quickly and don't make the same mistake twice.



REQUIREMENTS

- CPA (Philippines) or BS Accountancy required; CPA strongly preferred

- 3+ years of accounting experience with US clients

- Hands-on trust accounting experience (property management, escrow, or client funds)

- Vacation rental / short-term rental or property management accounting experience

- US real estate accounting experience (rental properties, depreciation, capital improvements, multiple entities)

- Strong QuickBooks Online and Excel / Google Sheets skills

- Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your accounting work, or a strong desire to

- Excellent written English

- Reliable internet, backup power, and at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours



Nice to have: Hospitable, Guesty, OwnerRez or another vacation rental PMS; month-end close for multiple entities; owner statement experience; Asana.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Stable full-time role with a growing US company

- Flexible schedule (with set weekly deadlines and US-hours overlap)

- 2 weeks paid time off plus Philippine national holidays

- Raises and bonuses as the company grows and you take on more

- A real path to Controller as we scale



HOW TO APPLY

Apply with your resume and a short cover note that includes:

1. Your trust accounting experience: what type of trust account, how many owners/clients, and how you reconciled it.

2. Your vacation rental or property management experience: which companies and which software.

3. A short answer to this: A guest pays $1,500 for a stay. That includes a $350 cleaning fee the management company keeps (the cleaner costs $290). During the month, the manager also buys $80 of supplies for the owner on the company card. The management fee is 20% of nightly revenue. How would you record this, and what does the owner get paid?

4. One example of a process you improved or automated in a past role, and the result.



Start your subject line with "Trust Ledger" so we know you read the full listing. Applications without the answer to #3 won't be reviewed.

description:
Content Creator & Social Media Manager: The Face of TAS Digital on Instagram



Part-Time | Remote | $500 - $700 / month



We're looking for a content creator who wants to build our agency's Instagram from the inside. You'll talk to camera about creative strategy, UGC, eCommerce marketing, eCommerce advertising and scaling brands, create UGC and AI ads, jump on trending ideas, film with our team, and run your own content calendar within TAS Digital, part-time.



As a Content Creator at TAS Digital, you are the face and voice of our Instagram, and you manage the ideas and content behind it. Your role is to turn what our strategists, editors and designers know into content people want to watch, save and share.



⚠️ BEFORE YOU APPLY

You must be a creator yourself: you film yourself with your phone, talk to the camera and explain things. This is the way you will work with us. Your portfolio must show videos of you talking to the camera.

This is an example of the content you will create: 

If you are not able to create content like this, please do not apply. Your spoken English must be fluent.



🚀 ABOUT US

At TAS Digital, we're a fast-growing European performance creative agency working with global brands across the world. We're a fully remote team of experts who are passionate about growth, both for our clients and ourselves.



Our culture is built on continuous learning, collaboration, and excellence. We believe in strong client relationships, strong team relationships, and giving everyone the independence to do their best work while working hard together toward shared goals. If you're driven, eager to learn, and ready to make an impact on a global scale, you'll fit right in.



📋 ROLE OVERVIEW

This is not client ad production. Nothing you make here runs as a paid ad for a brand. You are creating content for TAS Digital's own Instagram across five topics: creative strategy, UGC, eCommerce marketing, eCommerce advertising and scaling brands. On top of talking-to-camera content, you'll produce UGC and AI ads that show what we do. You'll own your content from idea to post: ideate (alone and with the team), script, film, and work with our editors to finish it.



🔍 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Be the Face of TAS Digital: appear on camera as the recurring creator on our Instagram, so people start to recognise you as us.

- Topics You'll Cover: creative strategy, UGC, eCommerce marketing, eCommerce advertising and scaling brands: hooks, angles, personas, ad teardowns, offers, what makes an ad convert and what is working in the market right now.

- UGC & AI Ads: create UGC ads and AI ads (AI avatars, AI visuals, AI voiceovers) that show our work and teach our audience how it's done.

- Ideation & Filming with the Team: join ideation sessions with our Creative Strategists, Editors and Designers and turn the best ideas into posts. You may also film content together with the team.

- Scripting: write your own hooks and scripts. You don't wait for someone to hand you a brief.

- Filming: film to a standard our editors can work with: clean audio, good light, usable framing and enough coverage.

- Working with Our Editors: hand off footage with clear notes, review cuts and iterate until the piece lands. Light self-editing for quick posts is a plus.

- Social Media & Content Calendar: manage your own calendar and idea bank, keep a consistent posting rhythm.

- Trending Ideas & Topics: keep an eye on trending ideas, formats and audios, and turn them into content for our niche fast.

- Performance Review: look at what performed on our account, understand why, and bring that into the next batch.



🎯 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Fluent, confident spoken English. Our audience is global and English-speaking.

- Natural and engaging on camera: you can hold attention and explain an idea clearly.

- A real understanding of what makes UGC work: hooks, angles, pacing, and why some videos convert and others don't.

- Interest in creative strategy, eCommerce marketing and advertising, and scaling brands, or the appetite to learn fast.

- Able to come up with your own ideas and write your own scripts.

- Organised and self-driven: you can run your own content calendar without being chased.

- Preferably experience in social media management, ideally running an Instagram account for a brand or agency.

- Preferably experience creating AI ads and using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, CapCut AI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Higgsfield and similar).

title: Senior Advertising Manager
description:
Senior Advertising Manager



Adverio | Remote | Internal Leadership Role



About Adverio:



Adverio is an Amazon marketplace advisory and execution agency helping mid-seven to nine-figure brands grow. We work across advertising, SEO, CRO, content, and business intelligence. For more information, please visit: 



What This Role Is:



You own advertising as a function. Not one account. All of them.



Every Advertising Manager works from the standards you set. When advertising performance holds up across the portfolio, that is your win. When it slips across multiple accounts, that is your problem to diagnose and fix, at the level that stops it recurring rather than patching it account by account.



Your leverage is methodology and people. You build the SOPs, the quality bar, and the campaign approval discipline. You develop the Managers and hold them to that standard. You track what Amazon, Walmart, and Target change and get it to the team before it costs a client anything. You run the weekly Advertising L10 and report the function's health to the Brand Strategist.



You are not in accounts day to day. Account strategy belongs to the Brand Strategist and the Advertising Manager. But when an account goes materially into the red and guidance, training, or process fixes will not turn it around, you go in and help fix it. That is not a failure of the role. That is the role, used correctly, when the situation earns it.



The line that matters: you do not enter accounts because it feels productive. You enter when the system cannot solve it and someone with your depth is genuinely what the account needs.



What You Will Do:



- Own advertising results, quality, and methodology across every client account

- Monitor portfolio-wide performance and diagnose declines at the system level

- Build and maintain advertising SOPs, frameworks, quality standards, and campaign approval thresholds

- Hire, develop, coach, and hold every Advertising Manager accountable

- Step into an underperforming account directly when guidance and training will not correct it

- Track platform changes across Amazon, Walmart, and Target and cascade them before they cause client impact

- Catch cross-account patterns and fix them once, properly, at the SOP or training level

- Run the weekly Advertising L10 and report scorecard, Rock progress, and capacity to the Brand Strategist

- Lead quarterly planning for the advertising function



What This Role Is Not:



- Not a client-facing seat. You do not run client calls or own client relationships

- Not day-to-day account management. Managers own their accounts, you own the standard they work to

- Not a Specialist management role. That sits with the Advertising Manager

- Not a seat where the answer to a performance problem is to take the account over by default

- If you need to be the person in the platform every day, this is the wrong role. If you want a team of Managers who all operate at a level you set, it is the right one.



Experience We Require:



- 7+ years in marketplace advertising, with Amazon as your primary depth. Walmart and Target experience is a strong plus

- Proven experience leading advertising managers or specialists, not just running campaigns well yourself

- Demonstrated ownership of advertising performance across a portfolio of accounts, not a single brand

- Current knowledge. Your experience only counts if the last twelve months are part of it. You should be able to tell us what has meaningfully changed in Amazon advertising recently and what you did about it



How You Work:



- You measure yourself by how your team performs, not by being the sharpest practitioner in the room

- You have hard coaching conversations early, directly, and without softening them into nothing

- Your instinct when something breaks is to fix the system so it does not break again

- You track platform changes because you want to, not because someone assigned it

- You know the difference between a problem the system should solve and a problem that genuinely needs you in it



How Success Is Measured:



- Advertising performance holds or improves across the portfolio

- Brands hit their advertising goals, and advertising is a reason they stay with us

- Every Advertising Manager operates from the same current standard

- Managers are visibly better this quarter than last

- Platform changes reach the team before a client notices anything

- Brand Strategists never have to train or fix a Manager's capability gap themselves

- Weekly reporting to the Brand Strategist is accurate and on time, every week



Location:



Remote. We are open on location and hire globally.



How to Apply:



Please send us your application letter and most updated CV. Application subject should be: "Applicant - Senior Advertising Manager".

title: Accountability Coach - $300/month
description:
We run a program where people hire a "Boss" for their personal life.



Our members are building businesses, writing books, releasing music, getting fit. They already know what to do. They just don't do it, because nobody is expecting them to.



So we give them a Boss. You would be that Boss.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO

You'd look after a few small teams, about 4 to 12 people in total.



Every week, each person tells you three times for each day: what time they'll wake up, what time they'll start work, and what time they'll submit proof of what they got done.



Your job is to notice when they don't. There will be a specific platform the check-ins will happen on (it looks like a regular chat for messages).



If someone doesn't check in at 7:00, you message them at 7:05. If they don't reply, you call them at 7:10. Friendly and direct, no lecture. Something like: "morning, missed you at check-in. what's going on today?"



The rest of the time you keep the team chats alive. Cheering people on, responding to their messages, seeing how they are doing, asking how the thing they were stuck on is going.



Once a week you run 20-minute 1:1 meetings with each member of your team as a quick weekly touch base on their goals, and helping them plan their next week's worth of check-ins.



THE SCHEDULE

Depending on how many members are assigned to you, your work will fluctuate. Check-ins are as quick as responding to a message, with more time spent texting/calling them if they haven't shown up. As these times range throughout the day, most of the day will be flexible. Check-ins will go from Monday through Saturday, with no check-ins Sunday apart from the 1:1 meetings.



Hours are flexible and accommodating as you may give away check-ins that don't work with your schedule to others. Pay based on overall experience, fit, English ability, coaching ability and number of members assigned. Full roster can range between $300/month to $400 with potential to increase to $500/month based on performance.



Between those check-in times, your time is your own. Most people do this alongside other work, and that is completely fine. We encourage it.



We are hiring for two shifts:

- US time zone

- European/Asian time zone



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Reliable. This is the whole job. If you say you will message someone at 7:05, you message them at 7:05.

- Organized. You will be tracking 12 people's schedules without dropping anyone.

- Warm and easy to talk to. People should be glad you messaged them.

- Excellent English, written and spoken. You will be on video every week. Clear and easy to understand.

- Reliable 24/7 access to internet, with a backup, and a plan for brownouts.

- A good camera and microphone.

- Comfortable sending text messages and making short phone calls.



Experience in customer support, online English teaching, client success, or community management is a big plus. Coaching experience is a plus too.



HOW TO APPLY

Send an
 to 
 with a video of yourself explaining why you're interested in the job, how you spend the rest of your time (what other obligations do you have), and why you'd be a good fit. Please don't rehearse your answers or read them off the screen. Just talk to us naturally!

title: Virtual Assistant – Hotel Housekeeping Operations (AUS)

Zecco Property Services (ZECCO Pty Ltd) is a Melbourne-based commercial property services and hotel housekeeping company. We supply contracted housekeepers and room attendants to hotels and serviced apartments in Melbourne — including Essence Hotel, Eminence, Paragon, 100 Exhibition and The Sebel Docklands — and we also engage contractors in Sydney.



We are hiring a remote Virtual Assistant, part time, to help run the daily operations of our housekeeping team. You will be the link between our hotel clients, our cleaners and management: keeping rosters accurate, making sure rooms are cleaned on time, keeping clients informed, and getting weekly invoices out the door.



This is a hands-on operations role, not a generic inbox-only VA job. Hours are flexible — you are not tied to a fixed 9-to-5 shift — but all deadlines are Melbourne, Australia time (AEST/AEDT), and certain tasks must be done at set times:

- Morning (or the day prior): send the team brief and the timing calculation.

- Midday: check the team and make sure cleaning is on time.

- Before 5:00pm Melbourne time: finalise roster amendments, and make sure texts and client requests have been addressed.

- End of day: confirm all cleans are done.



We require a response within 10 minutes when we or the team message you. Client requests are uncommon — most are handled by onsite housekeepers — but you need to make sure each one has been addressed. During the day you may also get texts from management or team members; please respond so operations keep running smoothly.



We are looking for a long-term partnership. As Zecco expands, this role is expected to grow into a more full-time position.

Key responsibilities:

 (Gmail) and day-to-day coordination by chat (WhatsApp or similar).

title: 🚀 Head of TikTok Shop & trybe | Scale to 7 Figures
description:
We're Looking for a TikTok Shop Growth Leader!!



We're a rapidly growing DTC ecommerce company looking for an exceptional Head of TikTok Shop & Creator Commerce to take ownership of our TikTok Shop and Trybe operations.



This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for someone who knows how to turn creators into a predictable revenue and content acquisition engine.



We're not looking for someone to simply upload products, schedule posts, or send a few influencer messages.



We want someone who understands the business behind TikTok Shop — someone who can recruit hundreds of creators, build affiliate systems, identify revenue-driving content, and scale a creator ecosystem that consistently produces sales.



You'll have the opportunity to build and own an entire department, not just execute someone else's instructions.



If you've successfully managed TikTok Shop for an established ecommerce brand and are ready to take your experience to the next level, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Be Responsible For



1. TikTok Shop Growth & Management - You will own the performance and day-to-day operations of our TikTok Shop.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Managing the complete TikTok Shop operation

- Optimizing product listings, storefronts, and affiliate offers

- Developing strategies to increase GMV and revenue

- Recruiting and onboarding TikTok Shop affiliates

- Managing high-volume creator outreach and product seeding

- Building commission structures and creator incentives

- Launching affiliate campaigns, promotions, and creator competitions

- Monitoring shop health, account performance, and operational KPIs

- Identifying opportunities to improve conversion rates and revenue

- Building systems that increase creator activity and content production



2. Trybe Creator Commerce-  You'll also own our Trybe creator ecosystem and ensure it becomes a consistent source of high-quality content.



You'll be responsible for:

- Managing our Trybe account and creator network

- Recruiting and onboarding creators

- Managing creator activity, content submissions, and posting schedules

- Repurposing winning TikTok Shop content through Trybe

- Organizing creator content and maintaining a structured content library

- Identifying top-performing creators and scaling their output

- Communicating winning hooks, angles, offers, and concepts

- Encouraging creators to iterate on successful content

- Tracking creator performance, payouts, and retention



3. Creator Recruitment & Relationship Management- Creator recruitment will be a major part of this role. You'll need to know how to build a creator network that actually generates revenue.



This includes:

- Recruiting hundreds of potential affiliates and creators

- Identifying creators with strong sales potential

- Building relationships with high-performing affiliates

- Developing incentives that motivate creators to post consistently

- Providing feedback that improves creator content

- Creating campaigns, bonuses, and competitions

- Turning one-time creators into long-term brand partners

- Building a strong and engaged creator community



We don't want someone who simply sends outreach messages. We want someone who can build a creator machine.**



 4. Performance, Analytics & Reporting- You'll be accountable for the performance of the channel.



You should be comfortable tracking and analyzing:

- TikTok Shop GMV and revenue

- Revenue by creator and video

- Active and newly recruited creators

- Samples sent and sample-to-post conversion

- Videos posted per week

- Revenue per creator and revenue per sample

- Affiliate commissions and creator payouts

- Creator retention and engagement

- Trybe creator activity and content output

- Top-performing hooks, concepts, and creatives



You'll use this data to make decisions, improve performance, and continuously scale what's working.



 Who We're Looking For



This is a senior operator role. Direct TikTok Shop experience is mandatory.



You must have:

- Previous experience managing TikTok Shop for an established ecommerce brand

- Proven experience growing TikTok Shop GMV

- Experience managing TikTok Shop affiliates and creator programs

- Experience with creator outreach, product seeding, and affiliate recruitment

- Experience managing a substantial creator or affiliate network

- Strong knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center

- Experience identifying and scaling high-performing creators

- Strong understanding of direct-response ecommerce

- Excellent analytical and organizational skills

- Strong written communication and relationship-building skills

- The ability to operate independently and take ownership of results



Experience managing hundreds of creators or affiliates is a major advantage.



! Experience with Trybe is strongly preferred. !





This Position Is NOT for You If...

- You've only managed organic TikTok social media accounts

- You've never worked directly inside TikTok Shop

- Your experience is primarily social media scheduling

- You've never managed affiliates or creator relationships

- You've only worked with small influencer campaigns

- You need constant supervision or detailed instructions

- You're uncomfortable being accountable for revenue and KPIs



We need someone who understands that creator commerce is a business channel — not just a marketing activity.



What Success Looks Like:



Your mission is to transform TikTok Shop and Trybe into a scalable creator acquisition and content engine.



The goal is simple:

More Creators → More Content → More Winning Creatives → More Revenue



You'll have the autonomy to build the systems, processes, creator relationships, and team structure needed to make this happen. We're looking for someone who wants to take ownership, build something meaningful, and grow alongside a fast-moving ecommerce business.



Why Join Us?



- Own a high-impact ecommerce growth department

- Work directly with leadership

- Have the freedom to build and improve systems

- Make a measurable impact on revenue

- Help shape the company's creator commerce strategy

- Grow into a long-term leadership position as the business scales



This is an opportunity for someone who wants to move beyond execution and become a true channel owner.



How to Apply:



To be considered, please include the following in your application:

1. How many years of direct TikTok Shop experience do you have?

2. What is the largest TikTok Shop you've managed?

3. What monthly GMV have you personally helped generate or manage?

4. How many creators or affiliates have you managed?

5. Describe your experience with creator outreach and product seeding.

6. Have you used Trybe? If yes, explain how you used it.

7. Share examples of TikTok Shops or ecommerce brands you've worked with.

8. Briefly explain how you would build a creator program from 0 to 500+ active affiliates.



Please include specific numbers and examples wherever possible. Applications without direct TikTok Shop management experience will not be considered.



We're looking for a proven operator who can take ownership, build systems, and turn creator commerce into a serious revenue channel.



If that's you, we want to hear from you.



Message "Redlight" if you were able to read the whole job description and answer the screening questions.

title: SEO & AEO Specialist
description:
SEO & AEO SPECIALIST – Financial Advisor Marketing Agency

Full-Time · Remote · Night Shift



Type of work: Full Time

Hours: 40 per week

Shift (PH time): 8 PM–5 AM, Mon–Fri



Key skills: SEO · Technical SEO · AEO · WordPress · Google Search Console · Google Analytics · Semrush · BrightLocal · Local SEO





ABOUT MIDSTREAM MARKETING



Midstream Marketing is a US-based digital marketing agency that helps independent financial advisors grow. We build websites and run SEO, content, advertising,
 and PR campaigns for advisory firms across the United States. We also support a small number of nonprofit and local service clients. We are a close-knit, family-oriented team, and we look out for each other. We respect the time you spend with your own family and keep your schedule predictable.





ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced SEO & AEO Specialist to lead search visibility for our client websites. Your goal is to help our clients get found on Google and cited by AI tools such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity, and to show the results in clear monthly reports.



You will report to our CEO and work closely with our Director of Operations, Operations Coordinator, Web Developer and QA Specialist. You will manage SEO and AEO for several client websites at a time. This is a long-term, full-time role for a proven expert who follows a defined process: you will work from our checklists, SOPs and ClickUp templates, and every completed task is reviewed. We also welcome the experience and strategy you bring: if you know a better way to get results, our leadership team wants to hear it and is open to changing how we work.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Technical SEO

• Audit client websites and run monthly crawls covering indexing, sitemaps, robots.txt, redirects, canonical tags and broken links.

• Improve Core Web Vitals and page speed, or write clear tickets for our Web Developer.

• Write, test and maintain JSON-LD schema markup.



Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

• Measure how often each client is cited in AI-generated answers, and grow that share every month.

• Structure content so AI tools can find and quote it: direct answers, FAQ sections, clear entities and author bios.

• Stay current on changes in AI search and adjust our approach as they happen.



On-page SEO and content

• Research keywords, search intent and competitors, and turn the findings into monthly content plans.

• Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and images.

• Write and edit SEO content briefs and web copy, and refresh pages that are losing rankings.

• Publish and update pages in WordPress.



Local SEO and authority building

• Optimize Google Business Profiles and keep business information consistent across the web.

• Earn quality backlinks through digital PR, partnerships and relevant directories, using white-hat methods only.



Reporting and collaboration

• Prepare a clear monthly SEO & AEO report for each client.

• Plan, track and update all work in ClickUp.

• Use AI tools to work efficiently, and verify all output before it is published.

• Follow compliance guidelines for financial services content.





AI AND CLAUDE



AI is part of our daily work. Our team uses Claude to research, draft, audit and report, and we are building it into the SEO and AEO process for every client. We are looking for someone who already works this way and wants to take it further.

• Use Claude and other AI tools every day for keyword research, content briefs, schema drafts, site audits and client reports.

• Help us build and improve the prompts, workflows and Claude skills we use for SEO and AEO work.

• Check every AI output for accuracy and compliance before it reaches a client or a live site.





SCOPE OF WORK



These are the standing deliverables for every client website you are assigned. Each one has a deadline and a clear standard for "done." Work outside this scope needs written approval before it starts.



• Onboarding audit (technical, on-page, local SEO and AEO)

   When: Within 10 business days of a new site being assigned

   Done means: A written audit with issues ranked by impact, plus a baseline for rankings, organic traffic and AI citations



• Monthly task plan

   When: First week of every month

   Done means: All tasks in ClickUp, each with a description, due date and expected result



• Technical health check

   When: Monthly

   Done means: Site crawled; critical issues fixed or ticketed within 5 business days



• On-page and content updates

   When: Weekly, following the monthly plan

   Done means: Changes live, checked on the live site and logged in ClickUp



• Schema markup

   When: Whenever pages are added or changed

   Done means: Passes Google's Rich Results Test and the 
 validator with no errors



• Google Business Profile updates

   When: Following the client's monthly plan

   Done means: Posts, photos and business details current and matching the website



• Backlinks and digital PR

   When: Following the client's monthly plan

   Done means: White-hat links only, each logged with its URL and date



• Rank and AI-citation tracking

   When: Monthly

   Done means: Rankings, Search Console data and AI-citation share compared with the baseline



• Client SEO & AEO report

   When: By the 28th of every month

   Done means: Results, work completed and next month's plan, written in plain English



• Weekly progress update

   When: Every week

   Done means: What is done, in progress, blocked or waiting for approval



• Daily status note

   When: Before the end of every shift

   Done means: A status note on every open ClickUp task



Work standards

• Track all work in ClickUp so the team can see what is done and what is next.

• Follow our SOPs and checklists for every task type. If a step does not fit, ask in the ClickUp task before changing it.

• Before starting non-routine work, post a short recap of your understanding in the ClickUp task and wait for confirmation.

• Get approval before publishing new pages, and before changing the URL, title or main heading of any page that already ranks.

• Get client or compliance sign-off on financial advisor content before it goes live. Content must never promise returns or results.

• Test every change on the live site before marking a task complete. Our QA Specialist reviews completed tasks.

• Record what you changed and when, so any change can be reviewed or reversed.

• Report a sudden drop in traffic or rankings, a site outage or de-indexed pages to the Operations team the same day.

• Use white-hat methods only, and fact-check and edit all AI-assisted content before it is published.

• Use only company-provided logins, and never share passwords.



Outside this role

Paid advertising (Google Ads and Meta Ads), social media management, graphic design and website development beyond SEO fixes are handled by other team members.





QUALIFICATIONS



Required

• At least 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, including managing several client websites at the same time.

• Proven results, with Search Console or GA4 screenshots you can share.

• Strong technical SEO skills, including writing JSON-LD schema by hand.

• Hands-on AEO experience: you have helped a website get cited in AI answers such as Google AI Overviews or ChatGPT.

• Confident working in WordPress.

• Proficient with Google Search Console, GA4, and Semrush or Ahrefs.

• Local SEO and Google Business Profile experience with US businesses, using tools such as BrightLocal.

• Excellent written English.

• A track record of following written processes, checklists and deadlines, and of asking before changing an agreed approach.

• Regular use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.



Preferred

• SEO experience in financial services or other regulated industries, such as legal or healthcare.

• Familiarity with ClickUp, Claude, DataForSEO, Looker Studio or Agency Dashboard.

• Basic HTML and CSS.

• A bachelor's degree in marketing, IT, communications or a related field.



Please note: we do not use PBNs, link farms or paid links. If these are part of your approach, this role is not the right fit.





REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS



We are a fully remote team working across time zones, so you need a reliable home-office setup from your first day.

• Computer: a laptop or desktop with at least an Intel Core i5, AMD Ryzen 5 or Apple M1 processor and 8 GB of RAM (16 GB preferred), running Windows 10 or 11 or a current version of macOS. A second monitor is preferred.

• Internet: a stable fiber or cable connection of at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.

• Backup internet: a second connection, such as mobile data or a pocket Wi-Fi, of at least 10 Mbps.

• Backup power: a UPS, power station or generator that keeps your computer and internet running for at least 2 hours during a power outage.

• Headset and webcam: a noise-cancelling headset with a microphone, and an HD webcam. Cameras are on for team meetings.

• Workspace: a quiet, private space where you can take calls without background noise or interruptions.

• Tools: willing to install and use our time tracker (TMetric), ClickUp, Zoho Cliq and Zoom.

• Availability: online and reachable on team chat for your whole shift, replying to messages within 15 minutes.

• Attendance: request leave in advance, and message your supervisor before your shift starts if an emergency keeps you from working.

• Security: a computer used only by you, with current antivirus and system updates. No work on public Wi-Fi. You will sign a confidentiality agreement (NDA).





SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



• Full-time, 40 hours per week, fully remote.

• Fixed night shift: 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour break. This covers most of the US team's working day; your start time is confirmed when you are hired.

• Performance review after 90 days, based on the scope of work above.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. Your resume.

2. Two SEO or AEO results you are proud of, with Search Console or GA4 screenshots and a short explanation of what you did.

3. Your expected monthly rate for 40 hours per week.

4. Your earliest available start date.

5. A screenshot of a recent internet speed test, for example from speedtest.net.

6. Your computer specifications, and your backup internet and backup power setup.

7. Links to your LinkedIn and social media profiles (for example
, Instagram or X).



Applications missing any of the seven items above, or the keyword below, will not be considered. Shortlisted applicants will complete a skills assessment that tests both their SEO and AEO skills and how closely they follow written instructions.



To show that you have read the full post, please begin your application with the words "PAGE ONE".

description:
ABOUT LAPS

Laps is a new premium sports drink from Amsterdam: real coconut water with added sodium and magnesium, made for people who train hard. We launch in January 2027 in the Netherlands, Germany and the UK, on our own webshop, Amazon, TikTok Shop and in retail. We're going up against the sports drink industry, and we're not doing it quietly.



We don't run ads. We grow through people. Your job is to build and lead our Hydration Team: 100 creators who get Laps every month and share it with their audience. These are long-term relationships, not one-off gifting.



KEY DETAILS

- Part-time, long-term, remote

- 20 hours per week, flexible, with at least 3 hours overlap with Amsterdam mornings (about 4–7 PM Philippine time)

- Pay: $500–800 per month, depending on experience

- Start: January 15 or February 1, 2027

- Paid 30-day trial, with a review at the end



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Build the Hydration Team

- Find the right creators on TikTok and Instagram: runners, cyclists, triathletes, Hyrox and gym athletes. Mostly micro-creators (2k–50k followers) in NL, DE and the UK

- Write personal outreach in English for UK creators. For NL and DE creators, send our Dutch and German templates, personalised with the details we give you. Ongoing contact after the first message is in English

- Onboard new ambassadors and make them feel welcome from day one



Look after the team

- Be the main contact for every ambassador: check in regularly, reply fast, and know what's going on in their training (races, PRs, injuries, events)

- Celebrate their wins: comment on and share their content, send a note when they finish a race

- Keep ambassadors involved with brand news, new drops and team moments

- Collect product feedback and ideas from the team

- Make sure creators follow our brief and claim rules (we'll give you the list of what can and can't be said)



TikTok Shop Affiliate Center

- Run our affiliate programme in TikTok Shop: commission plans, creator collaborations, invites and sample requests

- Track sales per creator and per video



TikTok brand account

- Build the Laps TikTok account from scratch together with the founder

- Post and schedule content (we produce the videos; you post, caption and time them)

- Engage daily: reply to comments, duet and stitch creator content



Test, measure, improve

- Review every ambassador after 2–3 months: keep the top performers, replace the weak ones, keep the team at 100

- Flag who could become a paid partner

- Ambassador rewards are tied to results (new subscribers via their code), so tracking must be accurate



Run the system

- Prepare the monthly shipping list of creator samples (our operations colleague handles the shipping)

- Track who posted, collect content links and ask permission to reuse content

- Keep our creator database up to date (UpPromote / Google Sheets), with notes on every ambassador



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year in influencer relations, creator partnerships or community management for a consumer brand

- Hands-on experience with the TikTok Shop Affiliate Center (creator collaborations, commission plans, samples), ideally in the UK or EU

- Experience growing a brand's TikTok account

- Excellent written English with a warm, casual tone

- You enjoy building relationships and remembering details about people

- You can spot fake followers and low engagement quickly

- Comfortable working with Dutch and German templates

- Organised and reliable: you follow up without being reminded

- You follow platform rules strictly. Never offer free product or payment in exchange for Amazon reviews

- Bonus: experience with sports, fitness, food or beverage brands

- Bonus: you know influencer disclosure rules (#ad / #gifted)



KPIs AND REPORTING

- Sales (GMV) per creator and per video

- Ambassador performance: posts, content quality, engagement and sales via discount codes, affiliate links and TikTok Shop

- Team size held at 100 active creators

- TikTok account growth and engagement

- Weekly report: new and active ambassadors, posts live, sales, highlights and issues

- Monthly overview: top performers, creators to replace, TikTok account results



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line "Hydration Team" and include:

1. A short intro about yourself

2. Brands you've worked with and the results you got

3. Your 30-day plan and how you would run the 3-month creator review

4. Test task: find 3 creators in the Netherlands who fit Laps, explain in one line each why, and write the first DM you'd send to one of them

5. Your availability and hourly rate



Applications missing points 2, 3 or 4 will not be reviewed.

title: E-commerce & TikTok Shop Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT LAPS

Laps is a new premium sports drink from Amsterdam: real coconut water with added sodium and magnesium, made for people who train hard. We launch in January 2027 in the Netherlands, Germany and the UK, on our own webshop, Amazon, TikTok Shop and in retail.



You'll keep our online shops running smoothly: TikTok Shop, our webshop and our subscriptions. You work closely with the founder and our Creator Partnerships Manager. Amazon is handled by an external agency and is not part of this role.



KEY DETAILS

- Part-time, long-term, remote

- 10–15 hours per week, flexible, with at least 2 hours overlap with Amsterdam mornings (about 4–6 PM Philippine time)

- Pay: $300–500 per month, depending on experience

- Start: January 15 or February 1, 2027

- Paid 30-day trial, with a review at the end



WHAT YOU'LL DO



TikTok Shop

- Set up TikTok Shop for NL, DE and the UK with the founder: seller account, category approval, product listings and shop settings

- Manage orders, returns and cancellations

- Keep stock in sync with our fulfilment partner (Monta)

- Monitor and reply to reviews

- Make sure listings and the shop follow TikTok's policies and our product claim rules

- (Commissions and creator collaborations are run by our Creator Partnerships Manager)



Webshop and subscriptions

- Handle orders and customer service for our webshop (Shopify) and subscriptions (Firmhouse): changes to subscriptions, cancellations, delivery questions and refunds under our Satisfaction Guarantee

- Customer service is in English. For Dutch and German customers you work with our templates

- Keep a list of common questions and propose improvements



Fulfilment and stock

- Watch stock levels and flag when it's time to restock

- Follow up on shipping problems and stock discrepancies with Monta

- Ship the monthly creator samples, using the list from our Creator Partnerships Manager



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Hands-on TikTok Shop Seller Center experience (setup, listings, orders, policies), ideally in the UK or EU

- At least 1 year in e-commerce operations or customer service for a consumer brand

- Experience with Shopify; subscription tools (Firmhouse, Recharge or similar) are a plus

- Excellent written English with a friendly, clear tone

- Accurate and structured: you notice errors before customers do

- You follow platform rules strictly. Never offer free product or payment in exchange for reviews, on any platform

- Bonus: experience with food or beverage brands, or with fulfilment partners/3PLs



KPIs AND REPORTING

- Customer service reply time within 24 hours on working days

- Orders shipped on time and correct stock across channels

- TikTok Shop account health: no policy violations, good review scores

- Weekly report: orders and sales per channel, customer service issues, stock status and anything that needs the founder's attention



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line "Laps Operations" and include:

1. A short intro about yourself

2. Brands or shops you've worked for and what you managed

3. Your TikTok Shop experience: which markets, and what you set up or managed

4. Test task: (a) list the steps to set up a TikTok Shop in the UK for a drinks brand, and (b) write your reply to this customer
: "My subscription box arrived damaged and I want to skip next month. Can you help?"

5. Your availability and hourly rate



Applications missing points 3 or 4 will not be reviewed.

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency
