title: Instagram Animation Video Editor
description:
Staia is a fast-growing AI astrology app. Our content team, mostly based in the Philippines, makes short-form videos that reach millions of views every month across Instagram and TikTok.

We are starting a new Instagram account built on animation-style videos: short, story-driven animated pieces that look premium and feel unique. We are looking for one editor who will create all the content for this account.



What you will do

• Create animated short-form videos for Staia's new Instagram account, mainly using Claude (Anthropic's AI)

• Study reference videos and accounts, work out what makes them work, and turn that into Staia's own animation style

• Find video ideas and research what performs in this niche

• Keep every video on brand: Staia's colours, look and tone

• Take feedback fast and keep improving each version

• Deliver on time, every time. We move fast, and speed and urgency matter here.



Who you are

• You have strong taste. You can tell right away what looks premium and what looks cheap, and you care about that difference. This matters more to us than years of experience.

• You want to make animation-style content. If you prefer talking heads or podcast edits, this role is not for you.

• You are a video editor, ideally with some graphic design or motion design sense

• You have used Claude, or you are curious enough to learn it fast. ChatGPT is not the tool for this work.

• You take ownership: when something is unclear, you work it out and come back with a solution rather than waiting to be told

• You take feedback well and adapt quickly



What we offer

• $600 per month, full-time (40 hours/week), freelance contract

• Fully remote

• A small, fast-moving team where your work is seen and your ideas get used

• Room to grow as the account grows



Hiring process

1. Test task

2. Interview with our HR team.

3. Trial day.



How to apply

Send us:

1. Links to your best animation or motion work (Instagram, TikTok, Drive or portfolio). Short-form content preferred.

2. One or two sentences on an animated short-form account you admire, and why.

3. Whether you have used Claude before and what you made with it.

Start your application with the word "ORBIT" so we know you read the full post.

title: Exercise Library & AI Image Editing
description:
Virtual Assistant – Exercise Library & AI Image Editing

I am looking for a detail-oriented VA to update the exercise library our clients use. The goal is to make every exercise easy to recognise and ensure the images look consistent across the library.



You’ll start with the HUR machine exercises. Once we’ve reviewed that group together, you’ll move on to the rest of the custom exercise library.

What you’ll do

- Review each exercise entry and check that the name, image and side match the movement being demonstrated.

- Use AI image editing and our reference photos to create consistent images with a clear background and the same model in our uniform. We’ll provide a uniform photo.

- Show the actual HUR machine and its beam in each image. Check that the model’s position and machine setup match the exercise, and retain muscle-group highlights where shown in the reference.

- Put the side first in exercise names, such as Right Leg Knee Flexion, and add a clear L or R label to the image so clients can tell which side to use at a glance.

- Upload the finished images, update the exercise names and flag anything you’re unsure about for review.

What we’re looking for

- Experience with AI image generation or photo editing, including background removal and working from reference images.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep images consistent across a large library.

- Confidence updating content in an online platform.

- Familiarity with gym equipment, exercise terminology or physiotherapy is a bonus.

To apply, please send a brief summary of your experience, the image-editing tools you use, one or two examples of your work, and your hourly rate and availability.

title: Video Editor – Short-Form Reels & Ad Creatives (Speed + Organization Focus)
description:
We’re looking for a fast, highly organized video editor who can consistently clip and deliver high-quality short-form content. This is not complex or cinematic editing. We need clean, tight, retention-focused cuts done quickly and at volume.



You’ll be clipping short-form reels and posts for Instagram,
, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms, plus clipping ad creatives. Right now we’re at a bare minimum volume. Content and creative output will only increase from here, so there’s clear room to grow for someone who can handle the pace.



Pay Structure



$10 per reel



Expectation: 2–3 reels per day across the month (includes both organic short-form content and ad creatives).



What You’ll Do

• Clip and edit short-form reels/posts for Instagram,
, YouTube Shorts, etc.

• Clip ad creatives from longer footage or raw content.

• Deliver clean, high-quality edits with strong hooks, tight pacing, and proper formatting for each platform.

• Turn around work quickly and consistently.

• Stay extremely organized with files, feedback, and delivery.

• Take feedback well and apply it immediately.



What We Need

• Extremely fast. Speed is the priority.

• Extremely organized.

• Open to feedback and willing to be pushed.

• Able to produce high-quality edits without overcomplicating them.

• Reliable and consistent with daily volume.



We care more about speed, cleanliness, and reliability than flashy effects or advanced motion graphics. If you can cut cleanly, keep momentum, and deliver on time every day, you’ll do well here.



How to Apply



Please include:

• Links to 5-10 short-form examples you’ve edited (Reels, Shorts, TikToks, or ads preferred).

• The editing software you primarily use.

• Confirmation that you can handle 2–3 reels per day consistently, sometimes even big batches of 5-10+

• A short note on how you stay organized with higher volume.

• Applications missing samples will not be reviewed.



This is a straightforward, high-output role with clear growth as volume increases. If you’re fast, organized, and can execute clean short-form edits at pace, apply.

title: Senior Project Manager *Superstar Only*
description:
Have you led complex projects across multiple teams and done it while believing that beauty starts from within?



Can you own a full portfolio of projects, set the processes that keep a growing team on track, and deliver results on time and on budget when the stakes are high?



We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead strategic initiatives from start to finish, guide the people doing the work, and build the systems we’ll scale on. If you think strategically, care about the details, and want your leadership to support a brand that changes how people care for themselves, we’d love to hear from you.



ABOUT US

We’re a fast-growing holistic beauty company that helps people look and feel their best through natural, whole-body practices. Our remote team works with one of the fastest-growing holistic beauty creators in the world, followed by more than 3,000,000 people. We’ll share more details during the interview.



The people who do best here care about the mission as much as the work. If you already practice or follow holistic wellness, you’ll feel at home with us.



JOB QUALIFICATIONS

- Outstanding achievements, such as Latin Honors (Summa Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Cum Laude), excellence awards (e.g., “Employee of the Year”), or fast career growth into leadership roles

- At least 5 years of project management experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead role

- Experience managing several projects at once with cross-functional or remote teams

- Proven ownership of project budgets, timelines, and resource planning

- A track record of creating or improving project management processes, workflows, and SOPs

- Strong command of project management tools (e.g., Asana, ClickUp, 
, Notion, Jira)

- Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, content production, or consumer brands (a strong plus)

PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification (preferred, not required)

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Project Management, or a related field (preferred, not required)

- Executive-level written and spoken communication, with the confidence to present to and influence senior stakeholders

- Sound judgment and decisiveness in high-pressure situations

- Strong leadership: able to mentor, delegate, and hold team members accountable



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead the planning and execution of high-priority projects and company initiatives from start to finish

- Work with leadership to define project scope, goals, deliverables, and success metrics

- Manage a portfolio of projects at once, balancing priorities, resources, and budgets

- Lead, mentor, and coordinate internal team members and external partners

- Build and refine project management frameworks, workflows, and documentation standards as the company grows

- Spot risks early, put mitigation plans in place, and escalate critical issues with clear recommendations

- Give leadership regular reports on progress, performance, and key decisions

- Manage change requests, scope changes, and stakeholder expectations

- Track project KPIs and use data to improve delivery and efficiency

- Resolve complex problems and conflicts with sound judgment and professionalism



REQUIREMENTS FOR REMOTE WORK

- A reliable computer or laptop

- A high-speed internet connection, plus a backup

- A quiet, distraction-free workspace



WORKING SCHEDULE

- Full-time



BENEFITS

- Competitive salary

- Training and development opportunities

- A key role in shaping how a fast-growing holistic beauty company runs

- A clear path to senior leadership and operations roles



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Since this is a long-term position, there will be an in-depth qualification process. If you believe you have what it takes, here's what to do next:



Please click the link below, review the questions carefully, and share the required information.






If you believe you meet our qualifications and requirements, we encourage you to apply now and become a valuable part of our rapidly expanding company.

title: Virtual Assistant – Seeking Programmers for Long-Term Growth Opportunity
description:
Done For You Tax is a fast-growing U.S.-based bookkeeping and tax preparation firm. We’re hiring smart, detail-oriented Virtual Assistants to join our team. Many of our current VAs come from a programming background—while the tasks aren't coding-related, the technical thinking and problem-solving skills of programmers are a perfect fit for the work we do.



We currently have about 20 former programmers working in VA roles across our company. Most of our team members stay with us long-term because they enjoy the work, the culture, and our mission to build a world-class company while providing meaningful, well-paying careers.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To apply, you must complete our aptitude and programming assessment through TestGorilla. This is the only way to apply for this position.



Assessment Link: 



IMPORTANT: TESTGORILLA ASSESSMENT POLICY



We actively monitor TestGorilla assessments for the use of AI and other forms of cheating. All assessment results will be reviewed before candidates are invited for an interview.



- You must complete the assessment independently.

- The use of AI tools or any unauthorized assistance during the assessment is strictly prohibited.

- Candidates caught cheating or using AI to gain an unfair advantage will be automatically disqualified.



We value genuine problem-solving skills, honesty, and integrity. Please complete the assessment using your own knowledge and abilities.



WHY JOIN US?



- Long-term, stable employment

- Competitive starting pay: $4–$5/hour, with consistent increases.

- U.S. working hours: Typically 9 PM – 5 AM Philippine time, depending on the assignment.

- Supportive, high-performing team

- Real growth opportunities: We promote from within.



If you're smart, responsible, detail-oriented, and ready to grow with a company that values its people, we encourage you to apply!

title: Part-Time US Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online), Remote, 20 hrs/week
description:
MGEMS Tax Pros is a U.S. tax and accounting firm in New Jersey. We're looking for an experienced bookkeeper.



What you'll do

*Set up and maintain a new QuickBooks Online file

*Categorize transactions and reconcile bank and credit card accounts every month

*Record W-2 payroll, owner's draws, loans and equipment (fixed assets and depreciation)

*Manage New Jersey sales tax, including exempt work (Form ST-8)

*Keep Jobber and QuickBooks Online in sync without duplicate income

*Track profit by job

*Close the books each month and prepare a profit and loss report for review



Requirements

*5+ years of U.S. bookkeeping experience with QuickBooks Online

*Experience with payroll, sales tax and bank reconciliations

*Clear written English and reliable communication

*Able to work a day during U.S. Eastern Time

*Stable internet and your own computer



How to apply

1. Fill out our application form: 
 and the personal  identity audit. Read each question carefully and answer every required field.

2. Shortlisted applicants take a 20-minute online quiz.

3. Top candidates complete a short paid test and a final interview.

title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:



Home Health/Home Care experience

Clinical Operations Management experience

RN experience

Leadership experience

U.S. or PH healthcare experience

Overall fit for the position





How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Experienced B2B Cold Caller (Outbound/Inbound)
description:
Experienced B2B Cold Caller (Outbound/Inbound)



About Us



AI PSYOP is a US-based AI implementation, marketing, automation, and business consulting agency. We help service-based businesses increase profitability, improve sales performance, streamline operations, and scale through strategic marketing, artificial intelligence, and business automation.



We work with business owners across various industries, including HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, automotive repair, cleaning services, and other service-based businesses throughout the United States.



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced B2B Cold Caller who can handle both outbound prospecting and inbound sales inquiries.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply reads scripts, makes calls, and books appointments. We need a sales professional who can think independently, actively listen, understand business challenges, ask relevant questions, and confidently communicate with business owners and decision-makers.



You must be capable of adapting to different conversations without relying entirely on a script.



Key Responsibilities



* Conduct outbound cold calls to US business owners and decision-makers.

* Handle inbound calls and respond promptly to incoming leads.

* Build rapport and establish credibility through natural, professional conversations.

* Conduct initial discovery using consultative selling techniques.

* Identify prospects’ challenges in marketing, sales, customer service, and business operations.

* Understand prospects’ current processes, software, and business systems.

* Identify operational inefficiencies, potential revenue loss, and opportunities for improvement.

* Handle objections confidently and professionally.

* Schedule qualified discovery and technical consultation appointments.

* Follow up with prospects through phone calls, SMS, and
.

* Coordinate with management, marketing, sales, and technical teams.

Required Qualifications



* Minimum of 2 years of B2B cold-calling or outbound sales experience.

* Experience handling both inbound and outbound sales calls.

* Previous experience communicating with US business owners and decision-makers.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Strong English comprehension, clear pronunciation, and natural conversational delivery.

* Excellent active listening and critical-thinking skills.

* Strong discovery, lead qualification, and objection-handling skills.

* Ability to ask relevant follow-up questions without relying entirely on a script.

* Ability to understand and communicate complex products and services.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Comfortable receiving constructive feedback and participating in regular training.

* Reliable, accountable, proactive, and results-driven.

* Available to work full-time during US business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in consultative B2B sales.

* Familiarity with SPIN Selling and GAP Selling methodologies.

* Experience selling high-ticket services, SaaS, digital marketing, or business consulting.

* Experience working with US service-based businesses.

* Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Apollo, or similar CRM and prospecting platforms.

* Basic understanding of AI, automation, digital marketing, and business operations.

* Experience identifying business pain points and their financial impact.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Daily outbound call activity.

* Inbound lead response time.

* Quality of prospect conversations.

* Discovery and qualification effectiveness.

* Qualified appointments booked.

* Appointment attendance rates.

* Lead-to-appointment conversion rates.

* Follow-up consistency.

* CRM accuracy and documentation.

* Professionalism, attendance, and coachability.



We prioritize quality conversations and qualified business opportunities, not just the number of calls made or appointments booked.



Technical Requirements



* Reliable desktop or laptop computer.

* Stable high-speed internet connection.

* Professional noise-canceling headset.

* Quiet and distraction-free working environment.

* Backup internet connection.

* Contingency plan for power interruptions.



What We Offer



* Competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.

* Performance-based incentives.

* Permanent work-from-home opportunity.

* Full-time, long-term career opportunity.

* Structured sales training and professional development.

* Access to professional CRM, prospecting, and AI-powered sales tools.

* Opportunities for career advancement based on performance.



How to Apply



Please submit the following through OnlineJobs.ph:



1. Updated resume.

2. A 2-minute video introduction highlighting your B2B sales experience.

3. A brief summary of your previous sales campaigns, industries, and responsibilities.

4. Previous performance metrics, including qualified appointments booked and conversion rates, if available.

5. A sample cold-call recording, if available and authorized for sharing.

6. Your availability to start.



Please also answer the following scenario in your own words:



You are speaking with an HVAC business owner who tells you:



“We already use ServiceTitan, and we already have AI and automation in our business. Why would we need your services?”



How would you respond, and what follow-up questions would you ask to better understand their business?



Please use “B2B SALES PROFESSIONAL” as your application subject.



Recruitment Process



Shortlisted applicants will undergo:

* Live, unscripted cold-call simulation.

* Discovery and objection-handling assessment.

* Final interview.

This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for an experienced sales professional who understands the difference between making phone calls and creating genuine business opportunities.



If you are confident in your sales abilities, enjoy meaningful conversations with business owners, and want to build a long-term career with a growing AI and business consulting agency, we would love to hear from you.

title: Head of Landing Pages & Conversion Strategy 8-Figure DTC Supplement Brands | Remote
description:
Build High-Converting Funnels. Lead Creative Strategy. Drive Revenue.



We're a fast-growing ecommerce company operating multiple DTC brands in the health and wellness space, including an established 8-figure supplement brand and a second rapidly scaling brand. We're looking for an exceptional Head of Landing Pages & Conversion Strategy to take complete ownership of our landing page department across our growing portfolio.



This is an opportunity to lead the strategy, research, copywriting, development, and optimization of landing pages that directly impact revenue. We're looking for someone who thinks like a creative strategist, writes like a direct-response marketer, and leads like a department head.



This is not a traditional landing page manager position.



We want someone who can identify new opportunities, develop compelling concepts, write persuasive copy, lead designers and developers, and continuously improve funnel performance. If you're a proactive growth-minded operator who knows how to turn customer insights into high-converting experiences, this role is for you.



🎯 What You'll Own



1. Landing Page Strategy & Creative Research - You'll be responsible for continuously developing new landing page concepts and identifying opportunities to improve our funnels.



Your responsibilities include:

- Researching competitors, winning funnels, and emerging direct-response strategies

- Identifying customer pain points, desires, objections, and buying motivations

- Developing new landing page concepts based on market and customer research

- Translating winning advertising angles into dedicated landing pages

- Exploring new funnel formats, including advertorials, listicles, quizzes, and product pages

- Building and maintaining a pipeline of new landing page ideas and experiments

- Collaborating with creative strategists to align landing pages with advertising campaigns



We want someone who constantly brings fresh ideas to the table — not someone who waits for a brief.



2. Direct-Response Copywriting-  You'll own the messaging and copy quality across our landing pages and sales funnels.



You'll be responsible for:

- Writing persuasive, conversion-focused landing page copy

- Developing advertorials, product pages, and sales funnel messaging

- Creating compelling headlines, hooks, offers, and calls to action

- Adapting messaging to different customer avatars and awareness levels

- Researching customer psychology and competitor positioning

- Addressing objections and strengthening purchase intent

- Continuously improving copy based on performance data

- Ensuring all messaging complies with applicable advertising and supplement marketing requirements

- We need someone who understands why people buy — not just someone who writes good sentences.



3. Department Leadership & Execution- You'll take full ownership of our landing page department across multiple brands.



This includes:

- Leading and managing landing page designers and developers

- Assigning projects and ensuring high-quality execution

- Managing projects from research and concept through launch

- Establishing efficient workflows and production systems

- Coordinating with creative strategists, media buyers, and marketing teams

- Managing deadlines and ensuring consistent landing page output

- Identifying bottlenecks and improving departmental efficiency

- Remaining hands-on when needed to write, build, or launch pages independently

- You'll have the autonomy to shape the department's strategy, processes, and team structure.



4. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)- You'll be accountable for continuously improving the performance of our landing pages and funnels.



You'll be responsible for:

- Developing and managing a structured A/B testing roadmap

- Reviewing funnel performance and identifying conversion opportunities

- Testing headlines, copy, layouts, offers, and page formats

- Analyzing conversion rates, revenue per visitor (RPV), and average order value (AOV)

- Identifying underperforming pages and developing improvement strategies

- Analyzing test results and applying winning insights across our brands

- Collaborating with media buyers to improve the relationship between ads and landing pages



Your goal is to turn data into actionable improvements that drive more revenue and profitability.



5. AI-Powered Research & Page Development- We're a modern, performance-driven company that embraces AI to move faster and work smarter.



You should be comfortable using tools such as:

- Claude

- Manus

- ChatGPT

- AI-powered research and page-building tools

- Landing page builders and funnel development platforms



You'll use AI to accelerate research, develop concepts, write copy, prototype pages, and improve execution speed.



We value people who can combine strong marketing fundamentals with modern tools to produce exceptional results.



🔥 Who We're Looking For



 You MUST have strong experience in direct-response marketing and landing page strategy.



Our ideal candidate has:

-Exceptional direct-response copywriting skills

- Proven experience developing and optimizing DTC landing pages

- Strong creative research and market analysis abilities

- A deep understanding of consumer psychology

- Experience with CRO, A/B testing, and funnel analytics

- Experience managing designers, developers, or landing page teams

- The ability to develop new concepts independently

- Strong project management and organizational skills

- Excellent written communication

- A proactive, ownership-driven mindset

- The ability to manage multiple brands, projects, and priorities



Big Plus:



- Experience with 7- or 8-figure DTC ecommerce brands

- Experience in supplements, health, or wellness

- Experience developing advertorials and quiz funnels

- Experience working with performance marketing teams

- Experience with Checkout Champ



Experience using AI tools to build or optimize landing pages



🚫 This Role Is NOT for You If...

- You're primarily a graphic designer or web developer

- You only build pages from someone else's instructions

- You have no direct-response copywriting experience

- You don't understand conversion rate optimization

- You rely entirely on templates without strategic thinking

- You need constant supervision

- You aren't comfortable being accountable for performance



We need someone who can independently identify what needs to be done and take action.



📈 What Success Looks Like



Your mission is to build a high-performing landing page department that consistently produces new concepts, launches new funnels, and improves conversion performance across our brands.



Success means:

-A consistent pipeline of researched landing page concepts

-Faster landing page production and launch cycles

-Stronger alignment between advertising creatives and landing pages

-Continuous CRO testing and optimization

-Improved conversion rates and revenue per visitor

-A well-organized, high-performing landing page team



Your work will directly influence how efficiently we turn advertising traffic into customers and revenue.



💎 Why Join Us?



- Department ownership: Lead an entire function with the freedom to shape its strategy and execution.

- High-impact work: Your decisions will directly influence revenue and profitability.

- Multiple brands: Work across a growing portfolio of products, offers, and customer segments.

- Creative freedom: Bring new ideas to life and test innovative funnel concepts.

- Growth opportunity: Build and expand your team as our brands continue to scale.

- Performance-driven culture: Collaborate with experienced marketers who value speed, innovation, and measurable results.

- This is a role for someone who wants to build something — not simply manage tasks.



📝 How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Describe your experience with landing page strategy, creative research, and direct-response copywriting.



2. Share examples of landing pages, advertorials, or funnels you've developed.



3. Explain your specific contribution to those projects and the results achieved.



4. Describe your experience leading teams and managing landing page projects.



5. Share how you've used AI tools in your research, copywriting, or page development workflows.



6. Briefly explain how you would identify and develop new landing page concepts for an 8-figure DTC supplement brand. Please provide specific examples, links, and performance metrics wherever possible.



(failure to answer the questions will not be considered) 



We're not looking for someone who simply manages landing page projects.



We're looking for a strategic operator who can own the entire function — researching new opportunities, developing compelling concepts, writing persuasive copy, leading execution, and continuously finding ways to improve conversion performance.



If you're ready to take ownership of a high-impact growth department, we'd love to hear from you.



Message "greenlight" if you were able to read the job description and answer the quesrtions.

title: Accountant (Non-CPA) – UK Clients (Remote, Full-Time Contract)

You must also be fully available during the agreed hours. Please tell us about any other ongoing work when you apply.

You will provide your own professional home office setup, including a suitable computer or laptop, a reliable high-speed internet connection, and backup internet and power. To protect client data, screen sharing, activity-monitoring software and webcam monitoring will be used during working hours. Full details are set out in your agreement with us.

• Ensure transactions are correctly recorded in supplier, customer, and general ledgers.

Financial Reporting

• Prepare financial reports and supporting schedules.

Tax & Compliance Support

Payroll Administration

• Experience preparing financial reports, reconciliations, and bookkeeping records.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills.

• Experience with payroll processing and VAT returns.

Technical Requirements

• Internet connection of at least 25 Mbps

• Backup internet (e.g. mobile data or pocket Wi-Fi) and a UPS or backup power supply

• Quiet, private workspace, headset and webcam

________________________________________

Key Competencies

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong organisational and time-management skills

• Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Strong mathematical and numerical skills

• Effective written and verbal English communication skills

• Ability to prioritise work and meet deadlines

• Professionalism, integrity, and accountability

• Strong customer service and relationship management skills

• High level of confidentiality and discretion when handling financial information

________________________________________

What We Offer

• Monthly pay of PHP 35,000 after the trial period, paid in PHP via Wise (we cover the transfer fees)

• 22 paid days off per year: the 12 Philippine regular national holidays plus 10 additional days

• 13th-month bonus

• HMO medical cover after 12 months' continuous service

• Long-term engagement following successful completion of the trial period

• Scope for greater responsibility and increased pay

• Fully remote work arrangement

• Supportive and collaborative team environment

________________________________________

Working Schedule

• Philippine time: 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM from late October to late March, and 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM from late March to late October (when UK clocks change)

How to Apply

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your application with the subject line "UK-ACC-2026". Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed. Please include:

Selection Process

Before starting, successful candidates will need to provide references and sign an agreement covering confidentiality, data protection and intellectual property. An NBI clearance may also be requested.

________________________________________

Join Our Team

If you are a motivated accounting professional with strong bookkeeping and financial reporting skills, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and build a rewarding long-term career with an organisation that values professionalism, accuracy, integrity, and continuous development.

title: Quality Assurance Team Lead (KYC/KYB Experience)
description:
Key Responsibilities

– Build and implement the KYC/KYB QA framework, including sampling, scoring and review methodology. Design the QA framework from the ground up, a risk-weighted sampling approach (higher-risk cases reviewed more frequently than lower-risk ones), a scoring methodology that captures both document completeness and the quality of the risk judgment behind it, and a review cadence that scales as case volume grows.

– Conduct quality reviews of KYC/KYB, CDD and EDD cases, including higher-risk customers. Independently review completed onboarding files checking risk-tier accuracy, screening disposition, source of funds/wealth evidencing, and (for entity clients) whether ownership structures were properly unwrapped to identify beneficial owners. Higher-risk and EDD cases receive closer scrutiny given the greater consequence of getting them wrong.

– Identify errors, trends and root causes and recommend improvements. Go beyond flagging individual mistakes — group findings by root cause (e.g. a documentation gap vs. a genuine risk judgment error vs. a partner-specific requirement being missed) so fixes target the actual cause, whether that's a training gap, an SOP gap, or a partner requirement that isn't properly documented.

– Develop QA reporting, KPIs and management information for the Head of Compliance.

– Own a regular reporting cadence covering quality trends, recurring error types, and partner specific RFI patterns — feeding a core KPI: reducing avoidable back-and-forth with our banking partners by catching issues before submission, not after.

– Work closely with the Head of Compliance to improve processes and controls.

– Act as the operational link between the compliance policy framework and how the team actually executes day to day — flagging where documented process and real practice have drifted apart, and helping close that gap.

– Identify training needs and provide feedback to onboarding teams.

– Use QA findings to drive what training actually happens — not generic refreshers, but targeted sessions addressing the specific gaps the data is showing (e.g. a pattern of source of funds vs. source of wealth confusion, or inconsistent handling of layered ownership structures).

– Continuously improve the QA framework as the business grows.

– Evolve the framework as new banking partners, products, or entity types are added.



Qualifications

– Must have at least 3 years of QA KYC team lead experience

– Must have experience in KYC, AML, Compliance or Financial Crime QA within fintech, payments or financial services.

– Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and risk-based onboarding.

– Direct, hands-on experience assessing KYC/KYB case quality (not general customer support QA experience). This role needs someone who can independently judge whether a compliance decision was right, not just whether a process step was followed.

– Experience building a QA framework from scratch. (This is a build role, not a maintain role. The successful candidate has built up a QA function before, not just operated within an existing one

– Strong understanding of QA methodologies, scorecard design, and performance evaluation.

– Comfortable designing scoring criteria that are consistent and defensible across reviewers, and calibrating so different reviewers reach the same conclusion on the same file.

– Genuine technical depth, able to independently assess whether a risk tier was applied correctly, whether EDD was sufficient, and whether an ownership structure was properly unwrapped, not just whether a checklist was completed.

– Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Able to turn QA findings into practical process improvements/training

– QA findings are only useful if they change something, this role needs to turn patterns into concrete process, training, or policy recommendations, not just produce reports.

– Confident, challenging decisions and escalating issues. This role will sometimes need to tell an experienced analyst, or flag to the Head of Compliance, that something isn't good enough.

– The end output of QA work here isn't a report that sits unread — it's a training session, an SOP update, or a process fix that actually closes the gap that was found.

– Must be comfortable using their own equipment

– Must be comfortable working Dubai hours

– Must be able to commit to working exclusively with the company and not be engaged in any part-time employment

– If you’ve read carefully the entire job description, please message us your updated CV with “QA Team Lead with KYC Experience” as the message subject

title: Procurement & Planning Coordinator
description:
The Company



Nutriseed is on a mission to make healthy living easy. Our philosophy is simple: every mouthful of food should be both nourishing and delicious. We have spent years creating and curating the highest-quality health foods, ensuring they are free from hidden sugars, additives, and unnecessary processing while remaining affordable and accessible.



As a privately owned, self-funded, and profitable direct-to-consumer brand, Nutriseed has achieved double-digit year-on-year growth, and we’re scaling fast. With ambitious plans to double our revenue and likely our team size within the next three years, we are looking for a Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator to bring structure, clarity, and control to our stock and supply.



This is a critical role in making sure stock is planned and bought correctly, supplier commitments are delivered, and decisions are supported by accurate, timely data. The ideal candidate will embody and champion our core values:



🔹 We Always Deliver – Taking ownership and ensuring high standards in everything we do.

🔹 We Have a Growth Mindset – Continuously learning, adapting, and improving.

🔹 We Are Accountable – Taking responsibility for actions and outcomes.

🔹 We Care – Genuinely caring about our team, customers, and mission.



Do you have the planning skills, supplier experience, and attention to detail to keep a fast-growing brand in stock?

If so, read on: this could be the opportunity for you.



The Opportunity



Nutriseed is seeking a Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator to own demand planning, purchasing and supplier coordination, and the accuracy of the data and systems behind them, with bounded, structured support to the Founder.

This role is critical in ensuring stock is planned and bought correctly, supplier commitments are delivered, and decisions are supported by accurate, timely data.



What We Need From Our Supplier Planning and Procurement Coordinator:



Demand & Supply Planning (Primary Responsibility)

Own the forecasting and planning of stock to ensure smooth operations and minimise risk.



Key responsibilities:



Build and maintain weekly/ monthly/ quarterly and annual demand forecasts (SKU level)

Translate forecasts into production requirements

Turn forecasts and stock cover into purchase quantities and order dates, allowing for minimum order quantities and manufacturing and freight lead times

Monitor stock levels, coverage, and risks (OOS / overstock)

Work closely with Operations to align production planning

Flag risks early and propose solutions



Success looks like:



No unexpected stockouts

Reduced waste / overproduction

Clear forward visibility of stock requirements

Procurement & Supplier Coordination (Primary Responsibility)

Own purchasing and day-to-day supplier coordination, so the right stock is ordered on the right terms and arrives when needed.



Key responsibilities:



Lead supplier coordination and negotiation, including with manufacturers in China: pricing, payment terms and delivery commitments, within agreed approval limits



Raise and manage approved purchase orders, and track them through production, quality checks, freight/import and receipt, working with the teams responsible for each stage



Keep purchasing records in Unleashed accurate, including order status, receipts and reconciliation with the warehouse



Give Finance visibility of deposits, balances and due dates when orders are committed and whenever plans change



Success looks like:



Purchase orders placed on time and in the right quantities

Suppliers deliver against agreed commitments, with issues flagged early

Accurate, up-to-date purchasing records

Finance has early, accurate visibility of supplier payments

Systems & Process Improvement

Ensure systems are working efficiently and processes are clearly defined.

Key responsibilities:

Support and maintain integrations (Shopify, Unleashed, etc.)

Identify inefficiencies in current workflows

Document and improve processes

Work with team members to implement better systems

Success looks like:

Fewer operational errors

Clear, documented processes

Improved efficiency across teams

Key KPIs

Forecast accuracy

Stock availability (minimising stockouts)

Supplier delivery performance against agreed commitments

Accuracy of purchasing records and commitments, including Finance visibility

Reporting accuracy and timeliness

Reduction in system/data errors

Process improvements implemented



Your Role and Its Boundaries

To ensure focus and sustainability, the following are not part of this role:

Fulfilment or dispatch ownership

Factory or production leadership, or sign-off of food quality

Budget, P&L or spending authority

Marketing ownership

Wider cross-functional project management; routine supplier, purchasing and stock coordination stays with this role

General executive-assistant duties for the Founder

Ad hoc/reactive tasks from multiple team members

Constant task-switching or firefighting

Undefined “catch-all” responsibilities

All work should align with the core responsibilities above.

Ways of Working

Clear weekly structure and prioritisation

Tasks owned end-to-end with minimal interruption

Requests prioritised and batched where possible

Regular check-ins to ensure clarity and alignment



Who is the Right Fit for This Role?



Experienced in International Purchasing – You have proven hands-on experience owning international purchasing, including working with manufacturers in China: orders, pricing, payment terms, lead times and delivery.

A Demand & Stock Planner – You have experience in demand and stock planning.

Detail-Oriented – You have strong attention to detail.

Analytical & Structured – You bring analytical and structured thinking.

Comfortable with Data & Systems – You’re comfortable working with data and systems.

Organised & Process-Driven – You’re highly organised and process-driven.

Great at Prioritising – You can prioritise and manage your workload effectively.

A Clear Communicator – Your communication is clear and proactive.



What’s in it for You?



✅ Own a clearly defined role with a structured weekly rhythm, in a fast-growing, values-driven company.

✅ Be part of a mission-driven brand that is transforming the health food industry.

✅ Competitive salary & benefits, with opportunities for growth and development.

✅ Grow your career into Operations Management, Planning & Supply Chain Leadership, or Systems / Data Ownership across the business.

title: Influencer / UGC Outreach VA for Clothing Brand - find creators, send DMs, track replies (simple, long term)
description:
Hi! We run a streetwear and hikewear clothing brand - jackets and tracksuits

mainly. We're looking for one person to handle our influencer and UGC creator

outreach.



This is a simple, repetitive role and we want to be upfront about that. It is

not strategy and it is not content creation. It is finding the right creators,

messaging them, keeping track of everyone, and following up. If you like

organised, steady work you will do well here.



THE WORK

- Find creators that fit the brand. Mostly Instagram and TikTok, small to mid

  size accounts, in Australia, UK and US.

- Send the outreach message. We give you the message and the offer, you adapt

  it so it doesn't read like a copy paste.

- Keep a tracker. Who you contacted, when, on what platform, what they said,

  what the next step is, what date to follow up.

- Follow up. Most of this job's results come from the second and third message,

  not the first.

- Chase deliverables. People agree to post and then go quiet. You remind them,

  politely, until it's done.

- Short weekly summary. How many contacted, how many replied, how many booked,

  who's gone quiet.



WHAT WE'RE NOT ASKING YOU TO DO

- Negotiate rates or agree anything with a creator. You check with us first,

  every time.

- Make content, edit video or design anything.

- Run ads or post on our accounts.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (please read this part properly)

- You have done outreach before. Influencer, UGC, affiliate, cold DM or cold

 
 - any of those count.

- A TRACKER YOU HAVE ACTUALLY USED. Google Sheet, Airtable, Notion, whatever.

  Blank out the names if you need to, we want to see the columns, not the

  contacts. Set it so anyone with the link can view.

- Good written English. These messages go out with our brand on them and they

  need to read like a person wrote them.

- Reliable internet and you can work the same hours most days.



HOURS AND PAY

Around 10-15 hours a week to start, long term, paid weekly.

$3-4 USD/hour depending on your experience, reviewed after the first month.

If you would rather be paid per outreach, quote us a price per 100 creators

contacted that INCLUDES the two follow up messages, so we're both clear what

a job is.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word HARBOUR so we know you read this.



Then send us:

1. Who you did outreach for before, and on what platform

2. A link to a tracker you have actually used, set to "anyone with the link

   can view"

3. How do you FIND creators in a niche? Tell us your actual method, step by

   step.

4. Write the DM you would send to a streetwear creator in Australia with 8,000

   followers, offering a free jacket in exchange for one post. Write it exactly

   as you would send it.

5. How many creators do you think you can contact in an hour, realistically?

6. What hours you can work, in your local time, and your time zone

7. Your WhatsApp number

title: Performance Graphic Designer for Beauty & Skincare Ads
description:
We’re seeking a Performance Graphic Designer to produce high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This position centers on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to interpret a creative brief, identify the right information hierarchy and visual format, and independently translate the strategy into a strong static ad built for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

- Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

- Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

- Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

- Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

- Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

- Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

- Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

- Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

- Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

- Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

- Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

- Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

- Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus.



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Scheduler / Staffing Coordinator
description:
Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM EST (that's 8:00 PM – 4:30 AM Philippine Time). This is a genuine night-shift commitment — please confirm you can sustain this schedule long-term before applying.



About You



You're confident and assertive on the phone. You can influence and persuade caregivers to take on open shifts — not just offer them and accept the first "no."



You're a creative problem-solver. When a shift won't fill the easy way, you think of options that make it work for everyone. For example, a caregiver hesitates at a client an hour away, so you point out that it's four days a week of steady, reliable hours, and they say yes.



You enjoy solving puzzles — a last-minute call-off is a challenge, not a crisis, and you stay level-headed while you fix it.



You have world-class written and spoken English. You'll be on the phone constantly with U.S. clients, families, and case managers — confident, clear, professional phone communication is non-negotiable, not a nice-to-have.



You have a sharp eye for detail and like things organized, accurate, and compliant — the kind of person who catches the error before it becomes a problem.



You're a natural completer who finishes what you start and doesn't let things slip.



You're a little competitive and like hitting targets — especially ones that contribute to team success.



You're willing and able to learn U.S. geography — specifically Delaware — well enough to make smart scheduling and routing decisions. We'll teach you; you bring the discipline to actually learn it.



About Us



We are a home care agency dedicated to compassionate, respectful, and professional service. We believe life is about living, not just existing — and that everyone deserves the dignity of care in the comfort of their own home. We deliver on that belief by providing the best care to clients in the communities we serve.



The Role



The Scheduling/Staffing Coordinator maximizes the efficiency and hours our caregivers deliver to our clients. You'll own the daily schedule: booking home visits for field staff, filling call-offs quickly, and keeping clients, caregivers, case managers, and office staff informed and coordinated. A big part of the job is actively persuading caregivers to pick up shifts — this role needs someone who leads the conversation, not someone who waits for answers. When schedules run smoothly, clients get consistent care and caregivers get reliable hours — you make that happen.



This is a high-caliber, well-compensated role. We're not looking for a generic VA — we're looking for someone who's genuinely excellent at this and will be paid accordingly.



Requirements



Minimum 5 years of scheduling/staffing coordination experience specifically within a home care agency (required) — this means coordinating field staff visiting clients in private homes, not assisted living facility scheduling and not generic staffing agency placement work

Hands-on experience with home care scheduling software (AlayaCare, WellSky, or similar) and managing multiple schedules simultaneously

Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Excellent spoken and written English — near-native fluency required; phone screening will specifically assess verbal communication

Proven ability to be assertive and persuasive with field staff — comfortable pushing for a "yes" on hard-to-fill shifts while keeping the relationship positive

Willingness and ability to quickly learn U.S. geography, specifically the Delaware service area, as it's central to daily scheduling decisions

High attention to detail and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced, compliance-sensitive environment

Proactive, creative problem-solving mindset

Healthcare certification (RN, CNA, or similar) is a plus



Responsibilities



-Ensure accurate and appropriate scheduling for clients and staff.

-Persuade and motivate caregivers to accept open shifts, finding workable solutions when a shift is hard to fill.

-Manage calls from patients and field staff regarding scheduling issues.

-Enter and maintain accurate information in the Home Care operating software (AlayaCare).

-Communicate professionally with clients, family members, and staff.

-Document and maintain schedule notations timely to ensure compliance.

-Provide staffing coverage for call-offs and monitor clock-in/out accuracy of field staff.

-Answer incoming calls promptly and pleasantly.

-Relay information from referral sources, clients, family members, and case managers to appropriate personnel.

-Document and report client or staff concerns.

-Maintain accurate documentation in client and personnel files.

-Adhere to company-wide and specific performance standards.

-Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to improve service delivery.

-Identify and proactively address scheduling challenges and process improvements.



How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Scheduler



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Funnel Builder (Funnelish)
description:
Type: Full-time, 40 hrs/week 

Location: 100% remote 

Rate: $4 USD per hour 

Overlap: Minimum 4 hours per day with CET (our core hours are 09:00–17:00 CET) 

Niche: Health & beauty · EU dropshipping Start: ASAP



The role:



We send you a winning competitor funnel from another market, and you rebuild it in Funnelish — better.



You get a link to the competitor funnel. You rebuild the structure and flow page for page: landing/advertorial, product page, checkout, order bump, one-click upsell, downsell, thank-you page. Then you upgrade it — our own product images and creatives, and sharper copy wherever the original is weak.



Health & beauty offers, sold across EU markets. Everything runs on Funnelish, synced with Shopify.



We expect a full funnel to take you a maximum of 2 hours. Speed matters here. If you need a full day to rebuild one funnel, this role is not for you.



What you'll do

Rebuild competitor funnels in Funnelish — page by page, matching the flow, layout and offer structure of the original

Swap in our own assets — our product images, our branding, our creatives. We don't ship someone else's images.

Improve the copy — rewrite headlines, hooks, bullets and CTAs in your own words where the original is weak. Never copy-paste the competitor's text.

Set up the checkout — order bumps, post-purchase 1-click upsells and downsells, payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal), correct currency, language and pricing per EU market

Build geo-funnels — the same offer adapted per country, with the right currency and local pricing

Wire up tracking — Meta Pixel / CAPI, TikTok Pixel, GA4. Every funnel goes live with tracking tested and confirmed working.

QA on mobile — most of our traffic is mobile and paid. Slow, broken or ugly-on-mobile pages cost us money directly.

Deliver volume — multiple funnels per week, live and ready for traffic

What we're looking for



Must have:



Hands-on experience building e-commerce funnels — Funnelish strongly preferred; ClickFunnels, Zipify/OCU, GemPages or similar considered if you can learn Funnelish fast

Fast and accurate with a drag-and-drop builder. You can look at a page and rebuild it without asking how.

A good eye — your rebuild should look better than the original, not like a cheap knockoff

Decent English copywriting: you can rewrite a headline or a bullet list and make it stronger

Basic HTML/CSS for tweaks the builder won't do

Comfortable with pixels and tracking QA — you can tell when an event fires twice or not at all

title: Crypto BD Team Lead: $1,500-2,500/mo Base Pace + Uncapped Deal Bonuses (Remote)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻

The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:

Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.

Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
