title: Senior Product Fulfillment & Supplier Negotiation Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing ecommerce store in the lighting and home decor space. We sell pendant lights, chandeliers, wall lights, ceiling fans, outdoor lighting, and decor products.



We are looking for an extremely detail-oriented Senior Product Fulfillment Specialist who can manage complex customer orders, communicate with multiple suppliers, negotiate the best price, verify that every order is correct, review QC photos/videos, and track every step in a spreadsheet.



This is not a simple “place orders” role. We need someone who can think, compare, question suppliers, catch mistakes before they happen, and protect the profit margin of the business.



Main Responsibilities



You will be responsible for managing product fulfillment from order confirmation through to delivery.



Your tasks will include:



-Review each customer order carefully before fulfillment.

-Confirm the correct product, size, color, finish, voltage, quantity, and variant.

-Contact up to 3 suppliers for pricing, availability, production time, shipping cost, and QC requirements.

-Negotiate with suppliers to get the best possible price for the business.

-Compare supplier quotes in a spreadsheet before choosing the best option.

-Confirm that the supplier understands the exact order requirements before production/shipping.

-Request and review QC photos/videos before dispatch.

-Check for visible defects, wrong colors, incorrect dimensions, missing parts, poor packaging, or anything that could cause a customer complaint.

-Track every order in a detailed spreadsheet with supplier, cost, status, tracking number, ETA, QC status, notes, and issues.

-Follow up with suppliers daily when needed.

-Escalate problems quickly instead of waiting until they become bigger issues.

-Look for ways to reduce costs, prevent mistakes, and improve our fulfillment process.



This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who



-Has experience managing ecommerce orders at scale.

-Has worked with multiple suppliers, agents, factories, or sourcing teams.

-Is confident negotiating price and asking suppliers difficult questions.

-Is extremely vigilant with details.

-Is comfortable working inside spreadsheets every day.

-Can handle complex orders with multiple variants, custom requirements, and supplier options.

-Understands that one small mistake can cost the business hundreds or thousands of dollars.

-Takes ownership and does not need to be constantly reminded.



Requirements



You must have:



-Proven experience in ecommerce fulfillment, procurement, sourcing, dropshipping operations, or supplier management.

-Experience handling complex product orders, not just simple one-click fulfillment.

-Experience working with suppliers, factories, agents, or manufacturers.

-Strong spreadsheet skills using Google Sheets or Excel.

-Excellent written English.

-Extremely strong communication skills 

-Very strong attention to detail.

-Reporting skills once per week 

-Ability to compare quotes, costs, shipping fees, and lead times.

-Ability to negotiate professionally with suppliers.

-Ability to follow SOPs while also thinking independently.

-Stable internet connection and reliable availability.



Experience in lighting, furniture, home decor, construction products, or high-ticket ecommerce is a major advantage.



Proof of Experience Required



In your application, please include:



-The previous companies or stores you have worked for.

-The type of products you fulfilled or sourced.

-Expected Salary 

-The average number of orders you handled per week or per month.

-Whether you worked with suppliers, factories, agents, or 3PLs.

-An example of a complex fulfillment problem you solved.

-An example of a time you saved money for a business by negotiating or comparing suppliers.

-Your experience with Google Sheets or Excel.

-Any screenshots, templates, SOPs, reports, or trackers you have created, with private information removed.





Applications without proof of relevant experience will not be considered.





Application Test Question



A customer orders 4 brass pendant lights for $2,000.



You receive these supplier options:



Supplier A: $160 per light, $280 shipping, ships in 4 days. However, the brass finish looks slightly different in their photos.



Supplier B: $190 per light, $220 shipping, ships in 10 days. They confirm the exact finish, correct size, correct voltage, and will send QC photos before shipping.



Supplier C: $145 per light, $330 shipping, ships tomorrow. However, the size is 5cm smaller than our product page and they cannot provide QC photos.



Which supplier would you choose and why?



In your answer, please include:



The total cost of each supplier.

The risks you see with each option.

The questions you would ask before placing the order.

The QC photos or proof you would request.

What details you would track in the spreadsheet.

An example of a similar situation you have handled before.



We are looking for someone who protects profit margin, catches mistakes, and does not simply choose the cheapest supplier.



RESPONSES ARE ALL AI PLAGIARISM-CHECKED. AI RESPONSES WILL BE FLAGGED AND APPLICATION WILL BE DELETED. 



Important Traits We Are Looking For:

Detail-obsessed

Honest

Organised

Strong negotiator

Good with spreadsheets

Calm under pressure

Able to catch mistakes early

Comfortable asking suppliers direct questions

Protective of business margins

Reliable with daily follow-up

Tools You May Use

Google Sheets

Gmail

Shopify

Supplier portals

WhatsApp / WeChat / email

Tracking websites

Internal SOPs and order trackers



Experience with Shopify is REQUIRED 



Working Hours



This is a remote role. We are looking for someone who can work consistently and provide daily updates. 40 hours minimum per week. 



Please include your preferred working hours and time zone in your application.



How to Apply



To apply, please send:



A short introduction about your experience.

Your previous fulfillment, sourcing, or supplier management roles.

The scale of orders you have handled.

Your answer to the application test question above.

Examples of spreadsheets, trackers, SOPs, or fulfillment systems you have used or created.

Your expected monthly salary.

Your internet speed and availability.

For a Christmas campaign, that might mean a reel that feels genuinely magical and makes someone want to buy the gift.



What you’ll do

- Bring us original ideas for reels, carousels, Stories and static posts, including hooks, visuals and timely trends worth using.

- Edit short-form videos in CapCut for Instagram, 
 and
. Choose the strongest opening shot, cut to the beat where it suits the footage, and use on-screen text and captions to keep the story clear.

- Design polished, on-brand graphics in Canva, including 3:4 Instagram posts and 9:16 reel covers and Stories.

- Write captions in UK English that sound like each client and give people a clear reason to book, buy or enquire.

- Schedule approved content in Metricool, checking the date, time, platforms, tags and locations. We’ll show you our workflow if you’re new to Metricool and keen to learn.

- Check the details before content goes live, including spelling, prices, logos, crops and video thumbnails.

What we’re looking for

- Strong CapCut skills and a portfolio that shows your judgement on hooks, pacing, audio and storytelling.

- Confident Canva skills, including working with brand kits, adapting layouts and retouching images.

- Excellent written English and the ability to adapt your tone and visual style across different brands.

- Initiative. If you see a stronger way to tell the story or a shot that would make the reel better, we want you to suggest it.

Experience in beauty, dental, healthcare or interiors is welcome. If you use ChatGPT or other AI tools to develop ideas or visuals, we’d like to see how you refine the work to fit the brand.



The starting rate is US$8–$10 per hour, depending on experience. You’ll start with one brand, with scope to take on more.



How to apply



Start your application with Studio 5 Wow and include the following through OnlineJobs.ph.

1. Your portfolio and three reels you personally edited in CapCut. For each reel, tell us what you did and share views, reach or engagement figures where available. Tell us which CapCut features you use most.

2. A short creative pitch. Imagine Kirstie Barton is offering her make-up masterclasses for £80 instead of £100 until Monday at midnight, and customers can buy one as a Christmas gift. In a few lines, tell us what you’d show in the first three seconds of the reel, what footage, text or audio you’d use, and how you’d end it. For the matching static post, share your headline, a short caption and the booking call to action. A written pitch is enough at this stage.

3. Your availability and a reference. Tell us when you can start and whether you can provide one client or employer reference, with their permission, if shortlisted.

Shortlisted creators will be invited to complete a short paid test. We’re aiming to make a decision by Monday 30 November, so please apply by Sunday evening UK time if you’re interested.

title: E-commerce Website Coordinator (WooCommerce)
description:
You'll manage the products on our WordPress website. That means adding and updating product pages, keeping prices and details correct, and checking that the website and sofa configurator work properly.



This is not a developer or SEO specialist role. It's for someone meticulous who enjoys getting product details exactly right.



You'll start with product updates, page checks and configurator testing. As you prove dependable, you'll take ownership of catalog audits, the configurator and the full website backlog.



The role owns the accurate implementation and maintenance of product information across:

• Adorn Croft's WordPress website

• All pages, including the high-traffic product pages and collection pages

• The sofa configurators

• Fabric and material options

• Pricing, measurements, descriptions, lead times, and related manual website updates



This is a detail-intensive website execution and product-data role.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



CORE PURPOSE



Ensure that every Adorn Croft product and customization option is published accurately, completely, consistently and on time, and that customers can use the website and configurator without encountering misleading information or broken functionality.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



SCOPE



1. PRODUCT CREATION AND MAINTENANCE

• Create and update product pages.

• Enter titles, descriptions, pricing, dimensions, materials, care instructions, lead times, shipping notes and customization options.

• Write basic SEO-friendly product titles, descriptions and meta descriptions using approved brand guidelines.

• Assign products to the correct categories and collections.

• Maintain SKUs, tags, attributes, related products and product status.

• Remove placeholders and outdated information.

• Apply approved formatting consistently.

• Verify that products, prices and product sizes match the company's master records.

• Test the pages for polished UX/UI on both mobile and desktop versions.

• Monitor Adorn Croft's website and configurator twice a week for broken functionality and report issues to the IT/marketing team.



2. CONFIGURATOR ADMINISTRATION

• Upload and organize fabrics, modules, wood bases and other options.

• Connect each option to the correct module and product, and correct any mismatches.

• Verify prices and price adjustments.

• Test the centimetre/inch toggle, layers, filters, undo/redo, saved sessions,
 links and add-to-cart flow.

• Report technical bugs clearly to the developer.

• You will maintain and test the configurator; coding and technical repairs remain with the developer.



3. WEBSITE MAINTENANCE

• Update menus, banners, text, links, buttons, promotional messages, policies, FAQs and collection pages.

• Check mobile and desktop presentation after every change.

• Identify broken links, missing images, formatting problems and outdated content.

• Maintain forms, downloadable files, embedded videos and basic page components.

• Conduct routine checks after WordPress or plugin updates.



4. PRODUCT-DATA QUALITY CONTROL

• Compare live pages against the approved product-information sheet.

• Audit pricing, measurements, materials, options and lead times.

• Maintain a change log showing what was changed, by whom, when and why.

• Conduct regular catalog audits.

• Correct inconsistencies across product pages, configurator entries, invoices and internal price lists.



5. DOCUMENTATION AND REPORTING

• Maintain upload templates and standard operating procedures.

• Keep a weekly record of published products, completed updates, detected errors and outstanding issues.

• Maintain the website request backlog.

• Document repeat problems and recommend process improvements.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



ACCOUNTABILITY



Own these five outcomes:

1. Product information is accurate and complete.

2. Approved website updates are published on time.

3. Configurator options and pricing work correctly.

4. The website is routinely checked for customer-facing problems.

5. Website changes and product data are documented and traceable.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



REQUIREMENTS



MUST HAVE

• WordPress product administration: hands-on experience creating and updating products, variations, attributes and categories (WooCommerce preferred).

• Exceptional attention to detail: meticulous with prices, dimensions, materials and options, and you check your work against source records before publishing.

• Testing and QA: you routinely check changes on mobile and desktop and test functionality before release.

• Basic product copywriting: you can write clear product titles and descriptions (basic SEO knowledge is a plus).

• Spreadsheets: comfortable using Google Sheets or Excel to compare and maintain product data.

• Organization and documentation: experience keeping SOPs, templates, logs or a task backlog (ClickUp or similar).

• Good written English



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with product configurators

• Furniture or home décor e-commerce experience



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



SCORECARD



ACCURACY

• 0 critical product-data errors published

• ≥99% overall product-data accuracy

• ≥95% of new or updated products have all mandatory fields complete

• ≥95% of work approved without avoidable correction



TURNAROUND

• Urgent price or policy changes: within 1 business day

• Standard product updates: within 2 business days of receiving complete information

• Complex or configurator updates: within 5 business days

• Website requests acknowledged: within 1 business day

• Broken links or missing assets found during routine checks: corrected within 2 business days



TESTING & DOCUMENTATION

• 100% of updated pages checked on desktop and mobile

• 100% of configurator changes tested before release

• 100% of completed changes entered in the change log



RELIABILITY

• 100% of approved tasks completed by deadline

• 0 overdue tasks without advance notice

• 0 unresolved critical website issues



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



PAY & TRIAL



• Hourly rate: USD $7–$9/hour, depending on experience and performance during selection.

• Paid trial and probation: shortlisted candidates complete a paid trial task. The selected candidate begins with a one-month probation period to confirm accuracy, timeliness, testing discipline and documentation.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. Your resume will only be considered if a recording is included.



 your application to 
 with the subject line:

Website Coordinator Application – [Your Full Name] – [Your Country]



Please include:



1. A 3–4 minute voice recording answering:

• Why are you the right person for this role? Tell us briefly about yourself and what in your experience matches what we need.

• Tell us about a problem you noticed on a website or store without anyone asking. What did you do about it, and what happened?

• How do you make sure product information is accurate before it goes live? Tell us about a time you caught an error before customers saw it.

• How do you test a website change and report a bug? Walk us through your process.



2. Your resume (PDF or Word)



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



ABOUT ADORN CROFT



Adorn Croft is an international e-commerce furniture and home décor company specializing in high-quality, customizable furnishings, including our signature modular sofas. We handle product design, factory sourcing, international logistics and online sales, and we deliver highly personalized service to customers buying bespoke furniture. Our distributed team works across time zones.

title: Planning & Forecast Analyst - OTB and Replenishment
description:
About the Role

We are a jewelry and accessories brand operating across DTC and Amazon channels, looking for a Planning & Forecast Analyst to own our OTB Planner and turn SKU-level forecasts into confident monthly replenishment buys.



Our OTB Planner was built in Claude and went live recently — it produces the numbers, and this role makes sure they’re right, explains what they mean, and improves the logic as we learn where it’s strong and where it misses. This is half analyst, half model builder: you’ll review every cycle’s output and challenge outliers, then build and ship the logic changes yourself directly in Claude.



Our business runs on thousands of SKUs, many of which launch strong and fade quickly — making demand hard to predict. This role exists to model those launch-and-fade patterns and keep the buy right across the whole assortment.



Work Structure & Requirements



🏠 Location: Remote / Virtual (Philippines)

📅 Schedule: Full-time

🌏 Time Zone: EST — available 8:00 AM–2:00 PM Eastern for live collaboration with the team

💵 Compensation: $12–$15 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



1. Monthly Replenishment Cycle



Run the OTB Planner each month and prepare the recommended replenishment buy for DTC and Amazon

Review SKU-level forecasts line by line before they become POs; flag and resolve outliers

Reconcile the SKU-level buy back to the OTB dollar plan by channel, category, and month



2. Data Analysis



Separate DTC and Amazon demand drivers — promotions, traffic, FBA constraints, seasonality, gifting peaks

Identify at-risk SKUs early: projected stockouts, overstock, and slow movers

Build simple, repeatable views that show the buy, the risks, and what changed since last month



3. Model Logic & Development



Model launch and fade curves: how fast new SKUs ramp, when they peak, and when to stop rebuying

Design and build logic updates (seasonality weights, safety stock, lead times, new-item and end-of-life rules, channel splits) backed by evidence

Back-test every change against recent history, get sign-off, roll it out, and roll it back if it underperforms

Version and document every logic change so the team always knows what the model is doing and why



4. Communication & Reporting



Present the monthly buy recommendation with a short read on risks and changes

Answer “why is the model saying this?” for merchandising, eCommerce, and Amazon partners

Lead weekly model reviews covering what sold vs. forecast, which SKUs are being missed, and what logic changes to test next



Required Skills & Experience



⚠️ AI Fluency: Works in Claude day-to-day to run, question, and update the planner — this is core to the role, not a nice-to-have

⚠️ Quantitative Skills: Strong math and modeling background — forecasting, statistics, and building and stress-testing model logic

Data: Comfortable working with large SKU-level datasets in Excel or Google Sheets

Attention to Detail: Catches the outlier SKU before it becomes a bad PO

Communication: Explains numbers clearly to merchants, eCommerce, and Amazon partners

Adaptability: Comfortable as the model, priorities, and data evolve month to month

Business Curiosity: Checks whether a number makes sense for the business, not just whether the math is right

Background: Analytics, finance/FP&A, data science, economics, or a similar quantitative field — retail planning experience helpful but not required



Nice to Have



Retail planning experience (OTB, replenishment, weeks of supply)

Amazon Seller/Vendor Central experience (FBA inventory, in-stock, replenishment)

DTC / Shopify eCommerce experience

Experience forecasting short-lifecycle or high-SKU-count products

Jewelry, accessories, or fashion retail background



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
About the Role



We are a jewellery and accessories brand with a growing e-commerce and retail presence. We're looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to keep our product in stock and moving. You will own the flow of inventory from purchase order to warehouse shelf — placing POs with suppliers, managing inbound shipments, reconciling invoices, and building the reporting that tells the team what we have, what is coming, and where we are at risk of stocking out.



This is a hands-on role that sits between our suppliers, our warehouse partner, and our finance and e-commerce teams. You will work daily in Shopify, Looker, and Sage, and you will be the go-to person for accurate, up-to-date inventory information.



Work Structure & Requirements

Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Full-time

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities

1. Purchasing & Supplier Management

Place purchase orders with suppliers based on demand, current stock, and lead times

Track and manage inbound delivery dates, following up with suppliers to keep shipments on schedule

Flag delays or supply risks early and work with the team on solutions

2. Item Master & New Product Setup

Own and maintain the item master, keeping SKU data accurate and consistent across Shopify, Sage, and warehouse systems

Set up UPCs and all required product information for new launch products at the time of ordering

Ensure new items are fully set up before their first PO is placed and inbounded

Partner with product development to get SKUs approved in time for PO placement

3. Inbound & Warehouse Operations

Create and upload Advance Shipping Notices (ASNs) to our warehouse partner for every inbound shipment

Manage the receiving process end-to-end, from arrival through receipt confirmation

Resolve discrepancies between what was ordered, shipped, and received

4. Invoice Reconciliation

Review all supplier invoices and match them against purchase orders and receipts

Approve accurate invoices for payment and route exceptions to finance with clear context

5. Inventory Reporting & Analysis

Build and maintain reporting in Looker, Shopify, and Sage to give the team a clear view of inventory health

Analyse stockouts to understand root causes and recommend changes to prevent them

Maintain daily reporting on inbound shipments and inventory levels

Communicate inventory status, risks, and changes proactively to stakeholders across the business

6. Process Improvement & Automation

Drive efficiency by using AI tools to automate manual processes across purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and reporting



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 3+ years in supply chain, inventory, purchasing, or operations — ideally in e-commerce or consumer products

Systems: Experience using ERP systems required; Shopify, Looker, and Sage (or similar e-commerce, BI, and accounting tools) strongly preferred

Purchasing: Hands-on experience placing POs and managing inbound shipments with suppliers and a 3PL or warehouse

Data: Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills including pivot tables, lookups, and recurring reports; comfortable reconciling data across systems and identifying discrepancies

Communication: Clear, proactive communication with suppliers, warehouse partners, and internal teams

Attention to Detail: Able to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously with high accuracy



Nice to Have

Experience with Airtable and SKU setup

Familiarity with ASNs, receiving workflows, and three-way matching (PO, receipt, invoice)

Experience with demand forecasting or reorder-point planning

Experience working on an ERP implementation project

title: Animator for Philosophy / History Youtube channel (Long-Term)
description:
I run a YouTube channel that explains philosophy and history with funny 2D cartoon animation, similar in feel to OverSimplified and Barely Evolved. I'm looking for a 2D animator to bring our videos to life on an ongoing basis.



WHAT YOU'D DO

- Animate our existing characters: layered PSD files made by our illustrator, each with separate arms, expressions and mouth shapes

- Lip-sync mouths to the narration, change expressions on the beats, and add simple movement (walking, reacting, crowds cheering, characters getting tossed in the air, and so on)

- Simple camera moves and effects: pops, whip transitions, small pushes, speed lines

- Time everything to the narration audio we provide

- We handle music, sound effects and captions ourselves, so this is animation only



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Narration audio for each video

- Layered character PSDs (14 characters so far) and painted backgrounds

- A rough storyboard or mockup showing what happens when



WHAT MATTERS TO US

- You use our characters as they are, without redrawing them in a different style

- Clear, funny timing; the jokes come from reactions and pauses

- Crowds and scenes where faces stay readable

- Being able to draw a new extra character or prop in the same style is a big plus, but not required

- No AI-generated characters or motion



TO APPLY, PLEASE SEND

1. Links to 2D character animation you've done (cartoon or explainer style preferred)

2. The software you use (After Effects, Moho, Toon Boom, Character Animator, etc.)

3. Your price per finished minute and your usual turnaround

4. Whether you can also draw characters and props in an existing style

title: Cold Caller/Real Estate Acquisitions
description:
Now Hiring: Cold Caller/Real Estate Acquisitions



About Us:

Mega Land Pros is a leading real estate (land) investment firm that is focused on acquiring and managing real estate assets. Our highly experienced team specializes in identifying opportunities, closing transactions efficiently, and delivering exceptional results. By combining industry expertise with advanced technology, data-driven market analysis, and streamlined systems, we identify investment opportunities and deliver fast, efficient transactions.



Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Cold Caller/Real Estate Acquisitions representative. This role will be critical in acquiring and evaluating land deals, analyzing comparable properties, researching markets, and gathering data.



This is a long-term, full-time position. You will be working directly with our U.S. team during eastern business hours.



Responsibilities:

• Make 100 to 200 outbound cold calls to landowners and potential sellers daily

• Identify motivated sellers and gather key property details

• Generate qualified leads daily

• Qualify leads based on motivation and property details

• Log all calls/notes into our CRM system

• Enter new leads in CRM or spreadsheet

• Flag at least 1 HOT lead per day for immediate team follow up

• Call and follow up with motivated sellers who respond to our cold-calling/direct mail campaigns

• Make initial contact with warm leads through phone calls, introducing yourself and the company

• Manage stages of transactions from contract execution to closing acquisitions.

• Refine offers, negotiate final terms, overcome objections, address seller concerns, and close deals by getting purchase agreements signed.

• Ask questions to gather details about the property, which include location, size, zoning, current use, and any other relevant characteristics

• Confirm ownership status of property.

• Identify lead's interest level for selling their land regarding their motivations, timeline, and any conditions they might have for selling

• Discuss lead’s price expectations and any flexibility for negotiations

• Build rapport and trust with the lead by actively listening to their needs and concerns, and providing our custom acquisition process

• Schedule follow-up calls as necessary to keep the lead engaged to maintain the relationship.

• Negotiate deals and make verbal/written offers based on property value

• Research land values using Zillow, Redfin, Google, and other tools

• Update CRM with seller details, offers, and follow-up notes

• Send contracts via DocuSign and track agreements

• Create new leads in CRM

• Generate comparable sales for properties

• Review the property details such as size, topography, flood zones, access, utilities, etc.

• Set follow up tasks and notes in CRM for closing manager

• Market analysis and research

• Ability to price properties using guidelines

• If needed, coordinate with title companies, buyers, sellers, and attorneys

• Follow SOPs and checklists

• Communicate clearly and effectively with the team

• Perform tasks such as ordering photography, land surveys, soil tests, calling utility companies and counties

• Miscellaneous real estate-based tasks



Qualifications:

• **Strong spoken English with minimal accent to communicate effectively with US-based clients**

• Experience with real estate, specifically vacant land acquisitions and land pricing preferred

• High energy with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Takes full ownership

• Follows checklists

• Meets deadlines

• Communicate clearly

• Ability to learn and work independently

• Proficient in Excel

• Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment



Soft Skills needed:

• Strong and fluent in speaking and writing English

• Detail orientated

• Kind and empathetic



Working Hours:

• Must be available between 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Eastern Time

• No other jobs are to be worked during this time. Working another job will result in immediate dismissal.



Pay:

• Base Salary between $4/hr-$7/hr+ (depending on experience)

• Performance-based cash bonus: $150-$350

• On-time payments



Why Join Us:

• Work with a dynamic team in a high-growth industry focused on land investment

• Flexible, remote work environment that fosters independence and creativity

• Opportunity for rapid career advancement within the firm

• Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses



How to Apply:

Record a 3-5 minute Loom video with an introduction of yourself, then answer the following questions:



1. What is your experience in cold calling real estate or land acquisitions?

2. How would you negotiate with a seller who is unsure about selling?

3. How would you price per acre for a 5 acre property in a rural area?

4. What tools have you used and how do you research land parcels?



Include the Loom video link in your application email.



Use the subject line: “Real Estate Lead/Acquisitions Manager - Your Name”



Send your resume to 
 highlighting your experience with real estate acquisitions, land pricing, and data management.



Important:

Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

Familiarity with Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), A/B testing, UX, basic front-end concepts, or Google Analytics is a huge plus.

Above-Market Pay: Competitive monthly base compensation.

Performance & Reporting

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

• A strong understanding of hooks, storytelling, retention curves, and content packaging.

• An experimental mindset: test, measure, learn, improve, repeat.

What Success Looks Like



• Consistent improvement in organic reach, retention, and engagement.

• A growing library of proven, repeatable content formats.

• Clear, data-backed explanations of what works, what doesn't, and why.

title: Amazon.ca Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA — Paid Per Lead, 3 Lead Types (Keepa + SellerAmp Experience Required)
description:
About us

3SBF Trading Inc. is a Canadian Amazon FBA seller (Amazon.ca only), newly launched and building our catalogue carefully — account health first, profit second, growth third. We source for ourselves every day, so we know honestly: full-standard leads are rare. We would rather pay fairly for a few real leads than receive a flood of weak ones.



The job

Find online arbitrage products from Canadian online retailers for resale on Amazon.ca. You will research, verify each product in Keepa and SellerAmp (we provide both accounts), and submit leads in our Google Sheet format. Flexible hours, output-based — part-time to start, more work for performers.



Pay — three lead types (paid weekly via Wise, after our internal review)

- Type 1 — Full lead: US$8. Meets ALL hard rules below AND at least CAD $5.00 profit per unit AND at least 25% ROI in SellerAmp at the current source price.

- Type 2 — Test-lane lead: US$3. Meets ALL hard rules below, but profit lands between CAD −$1 and +$3 per unit at the current source price. We are in a proof phase and buy small test quantities of these.

- Type 3 — Ungating candidate: no payment on submission. Profitable on paper (Type 1 economics) at a real source but RESTRICTED for our account in SellerAmp. Submit these separately, clearly labelled. If we pursue the brand, get ungated, and place an order based on your lead, you receive a US$5 bonus.

Quality over quantity, always. Leads that fail the hard rules are not paid, whichever type they were submitted as.



Hard rules — EVERY lead, EVERY type:

- Sold on Amazon.ca; new and sealed; FBA offers on the listing.

- Eligibility (Types 1 and 2): SellerAmp must show our account can sell it ("You can sell this product").

- Price sanity: the current Buy Box must be in line with the 3–6 month average on Keepa — no price spikes.

- Demand: at least 10 bought in the past month; sales rank in roughly the top 1–3% of its category.

- Competition: at least 3 FBA sellers; Buy Box shared fairly (no single seller taking 80%+); Amazon itself must NOT be a seller on the listing; the brand must NOT be selling its own listing.

- Product type: real third-party retail brands only. No private label, no generic/unbranded products, no IP-risk products.

- Source: a legitimate Canadian retailer, first-party only — the retailer itself, never a marketplace seller inside Walmart or another platform, and never eBay, Temu, AliExpress, or Alibaba. The price must be live at submission; include any sale price, promo code, or cashback you found.

- Rating 3.5 stars or higher (4.0+ preferred). Buy Box roughly CAD $10–$100.

- Flag anything hazmat / dangerous goods in your submission notes.



Zero tolerance: leads copied from shared lead lists, lead groups, or other sellers' lists end the engagement immediately. Every lead must be sourced by you, independently.

You will NOT be given: Seller Central access (not needed for this role), purchasing duties, or final buy decisions — we review and d
 every purchase.



Requirements

Proven online arbitrage sourcing experience (Amazon.ca experience strongly preferred)

Confident Keepa chart reading: price and sales-rank history, Buy Box share, offer counts

Confident SellerAmp use: profitability, eligibility, IP flags

Google Sheets; reliable internet; good written English



How to apply

Start your application with the words "Maple Sourcer" so we know you read this post. Then:

How long have you done Amazon OA sourcing, and for which marketplaces?

Your Keepa skill (1–10) and SellerAmp skill (1–10)?

Submit 3 sample leads for Amazon.ca, sourced within the last 7 days. At least one should be a Type 1 if you can find one — if not, send your best Type 2 leads and say so honestly; we respect that more than inflated numbers. For each lead: which type it is, ASIN, Amazon.ca link, source retailer + link, source price, Buy Box price, SellerAmp profit and ROI, and a Keepa link.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist | Payment Posting & Reconciliation
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Accounts Receivable Specialist to manage payment posting, account reconciliation, and financial record reviews.



This role focuses on ensuring customer payments are accurately recorded, matched to the correct services and jobs, and properly reflected in customer accounts. You will also review older transactions, identify discrepancies, and assist with collections when needed.



We are looking for someone with hands-on A/R experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while maintaining accurate financial records.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Post customer payments for approximately 3–5 hours per day.

- Match incoming payments to the correct services, jobs, and customer accounts.

- Review accounts to ensure payments have been entered accurately.

- Audit older jobs and transactions to verify that all payments have been received and properly applied.

- Identify missing payments, incorrect entries, and account discrepancies.

- Maintain accurate and organized accounts receivable records.

- Assist with collections and payment follow-ups when time allows.

- Perform other administrative and accounting-related duties as needed.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Previous hands-on experience in Accounts Receivable.

- Strong understanding of payment posting and account reconciliation.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial records.

- Ability to review transactions, identify discrepancies, and resolve payment-record issues.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and manage assigned tasks efficiently.

- Reliable internet connection, computer, and quiet remote workspace.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Experience handling payment posting for service-based businesses.

- Background in auditing customer accounts and reviewing historical transactions.

- Experience with accounting software, billing systems, or payment platforms.

- Collections and accounts follow-up experience.



PRIORITY SKILLS



- Payment Posting

- Accounts Receivable Reconciliation

- Account Auditing and Review

- Financial Record Management

- Administrative Support



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, organized, and experienced in handling accounts receivable transactions. You should be comfortable reviewing payment records, matching payments to the correct accounts, and identifying discrepancies without overlooking small details.



Accuracy and consistency are essential for this position.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. How many years of hands-on Accounts Receivable experience do you have, and what were your main responsibilities?

2. Describe your experience with payment posting, matching payments to jobs or invoices, and reconciling customer accounts.

3. What accounting or payment systems have you used, and are you comfortable auditing older transactions to identify missing or incorrectly applied payments?



APPLICATION INSTRUCTION

ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE - [YOUR FULL NAME]



Applications that do not follow the subject-line instruction may not be prioritized.

s to keep conversations moving. Keep the CRM current and give the owner a brief daily update on new leads, bookings, enrollments, and next steps.

 who to reach, what to say, and what to change when an approach gets few replies.



Strong phone skills matter here. You can put a parent at ease, ask a thoughtful question, listen to the answer, and confidently invite them to enroll. You’ll need C1 level or higher spoken and written English.



We value someone we can count on. When you tell a parent you’ll call on Thursday, you make the call. When an outreach idea shows promise, you take the next step without waiting for a reminder. Previous VA experience is preferred. CRM familiarity and an interest in dance are both welcome.



PAID TRIAL, BASE PAY, AND BONUSES



The role begins with a 2 week paid trial at 20 hours per week. You’ll receive $125 USD total for 40 hours. We’ll agree on your trial shifts in advance.



During the trial, we’ll assess your initiative, lead generation, sales ability, and reliability. We’ll look at the prospects you find independently, the conversations your outreach starts, which ones progress toward bookings or paid enrollments, and how consistently you follow through.



Candidates who demonstrate exceptional performance during the trial may transition to the regular 34-hour engagement ahead of schedule.



At the end of the trial, we’ll review the results together. If we both d
 to continue, you’ll move to 34 hours per week with a base salary of $450 USD per month, paid every 2 weeks through Wise.



You can earn performance bonuses on top of your base pay when your outreach consistently brings in multiple new paying students per month.



REGULAR SCHEDULE



All times are US Pacific Time.



Monday through Friday: 10 am to 2 pm and 4 pm to 6 pm, with a break from 2 pm to 4 pm.

Saturday and Sunday: 10 am to noon each day.



That’s 34 hours across 7 days. Both weekend shifts are required. We’re looking for someone who wants this to be their primary long term role and can reliably cover each shift. Hours may change seasonally within the studio’s 8 am to 9 pm Pacific window. We’ll discuss and agree on any changes in advance.



HOW TO APPLY



Include “Silver Slippers” in your subject line or message title. Send your resume, confirm you can work the full regular schedule, and answer this question in a few sentences:



Tell us about one sales opportunity you created from scratch. How did you find it, what did you personally do to move it forward, and what was the outcome?

title: Short-Form Tiktok Shop Video Editor
description:
I'm looking for a talented and reliable short-form video editor who understands TikTok, viral video formats, viewer retention, and product-based content.



I create content for TikTok Shop and UGC advertising. I will provide the raw footage, creative direction, and reference videos when necessary. Your primary responsibility will be turning my raw footage into engaging, natural-looking TikTok videos that keep viewers watching.



**Editing skills I'm looking for:**



- Experience editing native TikTok-style videos.

- Familiarity with viral video formats and editing techniques.

- Side-by-side and split-screen product comparisons.

- Overlapping audio and footage, including J-cuts and L-cuts.

- Removing dead space, unnecessary pauses, filler words, and awkward transitions.

- Strategic pattern interrupts to maintain viewer retention.

- Purposeful zooms, cuts, reframing, and changes in visual perspective.

- Relevant image, video, and product overlays.

- Proper overlay sizing, positioning, and timing.

- Incorporating B-roll that complements what is being said.

- Subtle, well-timed sound effects when appropriate.

- Clean audio, consistent volume, and natural pacing.

- Understanding how to maintain visual movement throughout a video without overediting.



**What I'm NOT looking for:**



- Excessive transitions or unnecessary visual effects.

- Generic, overly polished corporate-style editing.

- Random sound effects or overlays that distract from the content.

- Slow-paced videos with unnecessary dead space.



The goal is to create videos that feel authentic to TikTok while maximizing viewer retention and encouraging product purchases.



You will not be responsible for filming, writing scripts, creating on-screen text hooks, writing post captions, selecting hashtags, or publishing videos. I will handle those responsibilities myself.



**Requirements:**



- Previous experience editing TikTok or short-form social media content.

- Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.

- Strong English comprehension.

- Attention to detail and good communication.

- Ability to follow reference videos and implement feedback.

- Reliable turnaround times.

- Willingness to learn and continuously improve.



I'm looking to establish a long-term working relationship with someone who can grow alongside my business.



**How to apply:**



Please include the following in your application:



1. Three to five examples of TikTok or short-form videos you have personally edited.

2. Your experience editing product-based content or TikTok Shop videos.

3. Your preferred editing software.

4. Your expected hourly or monthly rate.

5. How many 20–90 second videos you can comfortably edit per day.

6. A brief explanation of the editing techniques you use to improve viewer retention.



Please include the word "RETENTION" at the beginning of your application so I know you have read the entire job description.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test.

title: Head of People (Recruiting & HR)
description:
We hire every month: right now that's 2-3 senior video editors a month, plus the roles around them. The hiring system already works. What's missing is one person whose whole job is running it, making it faster, and building a small sourcing team underneath them.



You'll report straight to the founder, own recruiting and HR end to end, and be the reason the team grows on time.





WHO WE ARE



Eyeball Factory is a performance creative agency. We make direct response video ads (VSLs, UGC ads, AI UGC and animated explainers) for 40+ brands, including IM8 Health, HelloNancy and Peachies. The founders built and sold a 7-figure e-commerce brand and grew a media company to 95,000 newsletter subscribers. We were founded in 2020, we're headquartered in the UAE, and the whole team is remote.





WHAT YOU'LL WALK INTO



Already built:

- Manatal as our ATS, with job posts live on several boards and 100+ applicants for our current editor role

- AI screening of new applicants, followed by a human check

- A ClickUp pipeline from shortlist to hire, with a scorecard on every candidate

- Interview guides, candidate
 templates and a hiring playbook



Yours to build and run:

- A sourcing team: 2 part-time Talent Sourcers in the Philippines doing LinkedIn and
 outreach, which you'll train and manage

- Outreach that runs every day, not only when someone has time

- Culture Index and personality testing for finalists

- Onboarding: a first-30-days plan for every new hire

- Weekly hiring numbers by channel, so we spend where hires actually come from





A NORMAL WEEK



- Every day: screen new applicants, take first-round calls (20 minutes, recorded), move candidates forward in ClickUp, and keep outreach going

- Every day: check your sourcers' numbers and unblock them

- Monday: hiring sync with the founder on open decisions and blockers

- Through the week: send trial briefs, collect scores, chase deadlines and onboard new starters

- Friday: a one-page report with applicants, calls, trials and hires by channel, and what you're changing next week





YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS



- Week 1: Learn the playbook, Manatal, ClickUp and Culture Index. Shadow first calls, and take your own by Friday.

- Week 2: Own every first-round call, the pipeline and daily outreach. Send your first Friday report.

- Weeks 3-4: Run the sourcing team against weekly targets, and Culture Index for every finalist.

- Day 30: You run recruiting end to end. The founder only sees shortlists and final decisions.



After day 30: hit the monthly hiring target, grow the sourcing team as needed, and build out the rest of HR (reviews, retention and team culture).





HOW WE'LL MEASURE YOU



- Senior video editor hires: 2-3 a month

- Application to first call: under 48 hours

- Pipeline accuracy: every candidate updated within 24 hours

- Sourcing team: weekly targets hit

- Trial to hire: tracked monthly, and rising

- Retention: hires still with us after 90 days





PAY AND SETUP



- $2,500-$3,500 USD a month base, depending on experience

- Quarterly bonus tied to hires and retention

- Paid in USD via Wise, PayPal or bank transfer

- Full-time, remote, independent contractor, with at least 4 hours of overlap with our working day in Dubai





YOU'RE A FIT IF



- You have 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting or HR for remote, international teams

- You've worked at or for a marketing, creative or ad agency (strongly preferred)

- You've built pipelines yourself through LinkedIn and direct outreach, not only by posting jobs

- You've hired, trained or managed recruiters, sourcers or VAs

- You've used personality or behavioral assessments (Culture Index, DISC, Predictive Index or similar)

- You live in your ATS: if it isn't logged, it didn't happen

- Your English is excellent, and you get to the point in writing and on calls



Bonus: you've hired video editors or other creatives, you use AI (Claude, ChatGPT) to screen candidates and write outreach, or you're Culture Index certified.





THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF



- You want to manage from a distance. This role is hands-on every day.

- You prefer big-company HR process to speed.

- You need a fully defined role. Part of this you'll build yourself.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply through our application form here:





The form asks for:

- Your CV

- Your LinkedIn profile link

- A link to a 3-5 minute Loom answering this: "You start Monday. We need 3 senior video editors in 30 days. Walk us through what you do." Tell us where you'd look, how you'd screen, and which numbers you'd track.

- Which agencies or remote teams you've hired for, and for which roles

- Your expected monthly pay in USD

- Your earliest start date



Start your cover letter in the form with the word "People" so we know you read this far. Applications without it won't be reviewed.



We only review applications sent through the form, and we watch every Loom. If the link doesn't show for you, apply here on OnlineJobs.ph and we'll send it to you.





HOW HIRING WORKS



1. Your application and Loom

2. A 20-minute call

3. Culture Index survey

4. Interview with the founder

5. A paid test project for one of our open roles

6. Final interview and offer

title: Warm, Friendly Male Narrator for Animated Philosophy Channel (Long-Term)
description:
I run a growing YouTube channel that explains philosophy and history with funny 2D cartoon animation, similar in feel to OverSimplified and Barely Evolved. I'm looking for a human narrator to become the long-term voice of the channel.



THE VOICE

- Warm, friendly and natural, like a smart friend telling you a story he finds funny

- Confident and clear, with dry, understated humour (jokes land through timing and pauses, not by shouting)

- Not a movie-trailer voice, not overly "announcer"

- Reference: the narrator of Fossil 
 natural and easy to listen to for 20+ minutes.



ON CAMERA (OPTIONAL)

- Now and then, a few short clips per video (for example an intro or a quick reaction). Only a small part of each video; the animation is the main thing.

- Showing your face is optional. You can film from the neck down, or with your face covered by our logo.

- If you'd rather do voice only, that's fine. Please still apply.



THE WORK

- 1-2 scripts per week, about 3,000 words each (roughly 18-20 minutes of finished audio)

- Ongoing for the right person

- Audio: WAV, 48 kHz, 24-bit, mono, recorded in a quiet space. Raw voice only, no music, no heavy processing, no AI voice tools.

- One free pickup round for mistakes or mispronounced names (a pronunciation guide comes with every script)

- Paid per finished script through Upwork



TO APPLY, PLEASE SEND

1. Links to your existing demo reel or past narration work (no custom audition needed)

2. Your price per ~3,000-word script, or your price per 100 words, plus anything extra for on-camera clips

3. Your usual turnaround time

4. Would you be open to us creating an AI clone of your voice for future videos? This would only happen with your written agreement and separately agreed pay. A "no" won't rule you out

s a week, follow-ups included

title: GoHighLevel Automation & Workflow Specialist
description:
ABOUT US



New Horizon Education is an Australian tutoring business supporting high school students. We’re looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to help complete and improve the automations supporting our enquiries, trial classes, enrolments, student communication and billing.



Our GHL account is already partly set up, with some workflows running. We have a detailed breakdown of the remaining work and need someone who can understand our processes, review the current setup and take responsibility for building, testing and documenting the remaining workflows.



THE ROLE



This is a technical implementation role. You’ll work directly with our founders to turn our business processes into reliable automations, reduce manual follow-ups and make sure tasks reach the right person.



The initial focus will be reviewing what exists, identifying gaps and completing the remaining implementation.



WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON



• Lead and enrolment workflows  

Improve the process from Instagram/Facebook 
 and forms through to parent calls, trial bookings, tutor feedback, post-trial follow-ups and enrolment.



• Team handovers and accountability  

Set up staff assignments, tasks, reminders and internal notifications so everyone knows what needs to happen next and leads don’t get missed.



• Student and parent communication  

Build workflows for onboarding, scheduled check-ins, paused enrolments, returning students, cancellations and program completion.



• Invoicing, payments and reporting  

Assess our planned move from Xero invoicing to GHL and help implement suitable billing workflows, payment tracking, overdue reminders and enrolment/revenue reporting.



• AI Instagram DM setting  

Improve our existing AI setter using past conversations, feedback and our communication style. This includes collecting the correct details and handing qualified leads to our team. AI replies must continue to be reviewed by our team before sending.



• Integrations  

Connect GHL with relevant tools, including Slack, spreadsheets and student-access systems where needed. Identify what GHL can handle directly and explain any additional integrations, limitations or ongoing costs.



• Testing and documentation  

Test the workflows from start to finish, including missing information, duplicate submissions and incorrect routing. Provide clear documentation or short walkthrough videos so our team can operate and maintain the system.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Demonstrated experience building and troubleshooting GoHighLevel automations.

• Strong understanding of pipelines, triggers, conditions, custom fields, tags, tasks and notifications.

• Experience connecting systems through automation tools, APIs or webhooks.

• Ability to work from a detailed written brief, identify gaps and recommend practical improvements.

• Clear written communication and regular progress updates.

• Careful testing, attention to detail and understandable handover documentation.



ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE WE VALUE



• GoHighLevel Conversation AI.

• Recurring invoicing, payment reminders and billing integrations.

• Instagram and
 messaging workflows.

• Slack, Google Sheets, Xero or Skool integrations.

• Systems involving separate parent, student and billing contacts.



You do not need experience with every tool listed, but please be clear about which areas you can handle confidently.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



The role is remote. Please include your availability, time zone and expected rate. We can discuss an hourly arrangement or a project quote after you have reviewed the detailed scope.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief overview of your relevant GoHighLevel experience.



2. One or two examples of workflows or systems you personally built, explaining what they did and which parts you were responsible for. Screenshots or a short Loom video are welcome—please hide any client information.



3. Your experience with Conversation AI, invoicing/payment workflows and external integrations.



4. A short explanation of how you would approach reviewing an existing GHL account before making changes.



5. Your expected hourly rate and currency, weekly availability and earliest start date.



We’ll share the detailed task list with shortlisted applicants so you can assess the scope, timing and any additional costs before we agree on the work.

title: Chief of Staff, Operations & AI
description:
About us

Innovative Business Development Group (IBDG) is the parent company behind a group of businesses that serve the American trucking industry: Innovative Logistics Group, iDispatchHub, iCoach360, CarrierLens, GoVantage and PerformanceOS. We help small carriers, owner-operators and new trucking entrepreneurs run real businesses through compliance, dispatch, coaching, software and back-office support. Our founder has spent nearly three decades in trucking and has been featured in The New York Times, MotorTrend and FreightWaves.



The role

Our founder runs several companies and has a demanding outside role. He needs one person who can run the day-to-day across all of them, manage the team, and make sure problems get solved before they ever reach his desk.





You'll be that person. You'll manage our offshore team, keep every company's recurring work on schedule, and decide what actually needs the founder's attention. You'll also build and run the AI agents and automations that let a small team do the work of a much bigger one. Every week, you should be asking which tasks a person is still doing that a well-built agent could handle.



This isn't an executive assistant job. You won't be managing a calendar. You'll be running a business and answering for results.



What you'll do:

Run the operation

Own the day-to-day across all IBDG companies, with a weekly operating rhythm: team check-ins, a scorecard for every company, and a written brief for the founder

Keep recurring deliverables on time, including daily blogs,
 newsletters, social media assets, customer filings and reports

Write and maintain the SOPs for how each piece of work gets done

Manage vendors, software subscriptions and the operating budget, and cut what isn't earning its keep

Handle escalations from customers, partners and the team, and solve them without passing them up



Lead the Team:

Oversee the offshore team across all IBDG companies, including assistants, content staff, sales, support, and People Operations.

Ensure every department is moving forward with its priorities, deadlines, and ongoing responsibilities. Follow up on outstanding tasks, delayed deliverables, and open positions to make sure nothing gets overlooked.

Provide oversight of recruitment, onboarding, training, and scheduling. Work with the responsible team members to ensure open roles move through the hiring process, new hires are properly onboarded, and schedules maintain adequate coverage.

Hold department leads and team members accountable for their assigned responsibilities, targets, and deadlines.

Review team performance through our internal HR platform, identify performance gaps, and coordinate coaching, improvement plans, or recommendations for separation when necessary.

Ensure department coordinators and team members have clear priorities, ownership, and expectations while allowing them to manage the day-to-day execution of their respective responsibilities.

Act as the primary point of coordination for operational follow-ups and escalations, resolving issues independently whenever possible and bringing only necessary decisions to the founder.

Keep the team connected, accountable, and productive across time zones.





Build the AI layer:

Find the manual work that eats the most hours, then replace it with AI agents and automations

Build and maintain agents using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Zapier, Make, n8n and Replit. That includes writing prompts, connecting tools, testing outputs and setting up human review where it matters

Track every automation: what it does, hours it saves each week, what it costs, and who checks its work

Train the team to use AI well, and set the rules for what AI can and can't do on its own, especially anything customer-facing

Keep up with new tools and bring us the ones worth trying





Protect the founder's time

Decide what needs the founder and what doesn't. Bring him decisions, not problems, with your recommendation attached

Prepare a short weekly brief covering wins, numbers, risks and the decisions he needs to make

Represent the founder in internal meetings and with vendors when he isn't there





What you need:

Native-level American English. You sound like you grew up in the U.S. You'll be on calls with American truckers, partners and vendors every day, and they shouldn't be able to tell you're offshore. We'll test this with a recorded call.

5+ years in operations, including at least 3 years managing a team of 5 or more people

At least 2 years working for a U.S. company on U.S. hours

Proof you've built AI agents or automations that run in a real business. Not just using ChatGPT, but setting up workflows that handle real tasks without someone babysitting them. Bring examples

Strong written communication. Your briefs, SOPs and
s need to be clear the first time

Comfortable making decisions without being told what to do, and owning the result

Able to work U.S. Eastern business hours, Monday through Friday

Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection, backup power and a quiet workspace





Nice to have:

Experience in trucking, logistics, freight or transportation

Experience running operations for more than one company or brand at the same time

Experience with Kajabi, WordPress, HubSpot, GoHighLevel or QuickBooks

Some hands-on technical skill, such as reading an API doc, writing basic scripts or building in Replit





How we measure success:

Fewer issues reaching the founder each quarter

Hours of manual work replaced by AI agents and automations

Team hitting its targets, and recurring work delivered on time

Operating costs kept within budget

About Innovative Logistics Group





Innovative Logistics Group is a Charlotte, North Carolina company that helps small carriers, owner-operators and drivers getting their own authority build real businesses. We handle compliance, dispatch, truck warranty, insurance support, invoice factoring, fuel cards and back-office help, and we offer one-on-one mentorship through iCoach360. The role

We’re not hiring someone to answer the phone. We’re hiring someone to pick it up. You’ll build your own lead lists, start cold conversations with carriers who’ve never heard of us, and turn those conversations into paying customers. Every new trucking company in the U.S. needs filings, compliance help, someone to find loads and a way to get paid faster. We have all of that, priced and ready to sell. What we don’t have yet is someone out there making noise about it every day.

If you need a warm lead handed to you before you can close, this isn’t your job. If you like building a pipeline from nothing and watching it turn into revenue, keep reading.

This is a full-time remote position for someone based outside the U.S. who can work U.S. Eastern business hours.



What you’ll sell:

Hand off cleanly to our compliance, dispatch, warranty and GoVantage teams, and to licensed partners on insurance and factoring

Check back with every customer within 90 days to find the next service they need

Log every lead, touch and deal in the CRM

Nice to have:

Our work combines strategic thinking, strong writing and high-quality design.

This is a senior role. You will set the content strategy, plan and run the content calendar, create and publish posts, and report on results, all with limited supervision. You'll report to the Founder, but we expect you to make the calls, bring ideas forward and own the results.

The role is 10–20 hours per week, depending on client workload, fully remote. You will need to be available for part of each day during Sydney business hours (AEST/AEDT) for client reviews and catch-ups.

You're an experienced, commercially minded social media professional who works independently and takes responsibility for results. You don't wait to be told what to post next.



Essential:

Experience: 2–3 Years Preferred

Reports To: Executive Assistant / Production Coordinator



About the Opportunity



We are a growing US-based podcast and creative media production company seeking a skilled, creative, and dependable Podcast Audio & Video Editor to join our remote production team.



We specialize in professional podcast production, audio and video recording, digital storytelling, and multimedia content creation.



The ideal candidate has strong technical skills in both audio and video post-production, experience editing multicamera podcasts, and the ability to consistently deliver polished, professional content.



This is a long-term, part-time opportunity for someone who enjoys creative storytelling, values quality, and works effectively within an organized remote team.



Key Responsibilities



1. Podcast Audio Editing & Post-Production (High Priority)



Strong professional audio editing skills are essential for this position.



Edit and enhance professionally recorded podcast audio.



Remove background noise, clicks, pops, unwanted pauses, and other audio distractions.



Apply EQ, compression, noise reduction, and audio leveling to achieve clear, balanced dialogue.



Synchronize externally recorded audio with video footage.



Balance audio levels across multiple speakers and microphones.



Edit interviews and conversations while maintaining natural flow.



Prepare professional audio masters suitable for Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and other podcast platforms.



Maintain consistent audio quality across episodes and client projects.



2. Multicamera Podcast Video Editing



Edit multicamera podcast recordings using footage from two or more cameras.



Synchronize multiple camera angles with separately recorded audio.



Create smooth, natural camera transitions based on speaker activity and conversation flow.



Apply color correction and basic color grading.



Incorporate lower thirds, logos, titles, and branded graphics.



Remove mistakes, unnecessary pauses, and distractions.



Produce polished long-form podcast episodes for YouTube and other platforms.



Export completed videos according to required specifications.



3. Short-Form & Social Media Editing



Repurpose podcast episodes into engaging Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and YouTube Shorts.



Identify compelling highlights from long-form recordings.



Create attention-grabbing hooks and promotional clips.



Add captions, subtitles, transitions, B-roll, and graphics.



Optimize content for different social media platforms.



Maintain consistent visual quality and branding.



4. Additional Creative Projects



Depending on production needs, assist with:



Music video editing.



Audiobook and spoken-word audio editing.



Promotional videos and advertisements.



Client testimonials and behind-the-scenes content.



Other multimedia post-production projects.



5. File Management & Collaboration



Organize raw footage, audio files, project files, and final deliverables.



Follow established file naming conventions and folder structures.



Maintain editable project files for future revisions.



Provide regular progress updates.



Meet agreed production deadlines.



Implement revisions accurately and promptly.



Collaborate with other editors and production team members.



Attend scheduled team and production meetings.



Required Qualifications



Professional Experience



2–3 years of relevant professional editing experience preferred.



Demonstrated experience editing both audio and video podcasts.



Hands-on experience with multicamera podcast productions.



Ability to independently edit long-form podcasts and short-form social media content.



Portfolio demonstrating relevant podcast editing work.



Technical Skills



Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.



Experience with Adobe Audition, Reaper, Audacity, or comparable audio editing software.



Strong knowledge of EQ, compression, noise reduction, audio mixing, and dialogue enhancement.



Experience synchronizing externally recorded audio with multicamera footage.



Basic color correction and grading.



Experience creating captions, graphics, transitions, and social media content.



Understanding of professional audio and video export specifications.



Additional Advantages:



Experience with CapCut, Adobe After Effects, or advanced motion graphics.



Experience editing music videos, audiobooks, or other multimedia projects.



Familiarity with organized remote production workflows.



Professional Qualities



We are looking for someone who is:



Detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.



Reliable, organized, and accountable.



Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English.



Able to follow creative direction and incorporate feedback.



Capable of working independently and meeting deadlines.



Proactive in communicating challenges and project updates.



Willing to learn and improve production workflows.



Work Schedule & Reporting



Employment Type: Part-time, 20 hours per week.



Work Arrangement: Fully remote, Philippines-based.



Schedule Coordination: Work schedules will be coordinated by the Executive Assistant / Production Coordinator.



Required Working Hours Overlap: Must have overlapping working hours with the Executive Assistant to ensure smooth communication, task coordination, and timely feedback.



Team Meetings: Must be available to attend scheduled virtual meetings, including meetings with the US-based production team.



Communication & Reporting: Regular progress updates, timely responses, and proactive communication regarding assigned projects are required.



Task Management: Daily assignments, project priorities, deadlines, revisions, and workflow coordination will be managed by the Executive Assistant / Production Coordinator.



Direct Reporting: The selected editor will report directly to the Executive Assistant / Production Coordinator.



Compensation & Growth



Starting Rate: $4 USD per hour.



Weekly Hours: Approximately 20 hours.



Employment Opportunity: Long-term, part-time position.



Performance Review: Initial review after 90 days.



Growth Opportunities: Potential compensation increases based on performance, quality of work, reliability, and business needs. Increases are not guaranteed.



Project Exposure: Opportunities to work on diverse podcast, audio, video, and creative production projects.



Equipment & Internet Requirements



Applicants must have:



A reliable computer capable of professional audio and video editing.



Stable, high-speed internet suitable for transferring large media files.



Access to appropriate editing software.



A quiet workspace suitable for focused editing.



A working microphone and camera for virtual meetings.



How to Apply



Apply exclusively through OnlineJobs.ph.



Please include the following in your application:



Resume/CV: Highlight your relevant audio and video editing experience.



Podcast Editing Portfolio: Links to your best audio and video podcast editing projects.



Multicamera Editing Samples: At least one example demonstrating camera switching and audio synchronization.



Short-Form Content Samples: Examples of Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, or YouTube Shorts.



Editing Software: List the audio and video editing software you are proficient in.



Computer & Internet: Provide your computer specifications and internet speed.



Availability: Confirm your availability for 20 hours per week, overlapping work hours, and scheduled team meetings.



Audio Editing Experience: Briefly explain your experience with podcast audio cleanup, EQ, compression, mixing, and synchronization.



Important: Applications without relevant podcast editing samples may not be considered.



Selection Process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a virtual interview and a paid practical editing assessment.



The assessment will evaluate:



Podcast audio cleanup and dialogue enhancement.



Multicamera video editing and synchronization.



Audio and video production quality.



Attention to detail.



Ability to follow instructions and creative direction.



Accuracy in implementing revisions.



Overall turnaround time and communication.



Important Application Instructions



All applications and recruitment-related communication must be conducted exclusively through OnlineJobs.ph.



Please do not contact us through personal
, social media, or other external platforms.



We are looking for a dependable, creative professional interested in building a long-term working relationship with a growing US-based production team.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Moving Consultant
description:
Moving Sales Consultant | Fully Remote



Elevate Moving Sales is growing and looking for motivated Moving Sales Consultants to join our remote sales team.



We work with moving companies across the United States, helping them follow up with leads, build estimates, and turn more opportunities into booked moves.



What You’ll Be Doing



* Calling and following up with inbound moving leads

* Speaking with customers about their upcoming move

* Gathering move details and building accurate estimates

* Following up with leads by phone, text, and email

* Handling objections and closing moves

* Keeping customer information and follow-ups organized in the CRM

* Working alongside our sales team to hit individual and company goals



Who We’re Looking For



Previous moving sales experience is strongly preferred.



We’re looking for people who are:



* Confident and professional on the phone

* Comfortable having a high volume of customer conversations

* Competitive and motivated by sales

* Reliable and consistent

* Comfortable working remotely

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Experienced with moving CRMs or moving estimates is a major plus



Fully Remote, But You’re Still Part of a Team



This isn’t the typical remote job where you work alone all day.



Our team works together inside a virtual office, where you’ll have your own virtual workspace that you can decorate and personalize. You’ll be working alongside the rest of the team throughout the day, making it feel much more like an actual office while still getting to work completely remotely.



Elevate Moving Sales is a fast-growing company with a competitive, rewarding team environment. We’re looking for people who want to grow with us and become a long-term part of the team.



How to Apply



Send us a message with:



1. A brief description of your sales experience, especially any moving industry experience

2. A voice recording introducing yourself and telling us about your experience

3. Your availability and preferred working hours



Please include all three when applying.



If you have moving sales experience and know how to turn leads into booked moves, we’d love to hear from you.
